pk-pixel-paint.title: Pixel Paint
pk-pixel-paint.description:
Pixel Paint is a relaxing color-by-number game where every pixel hides a number. Pick the matching color, drag your finger across the grid and watch a gray canvas turn into a cute pixel picture.

Start with a simple heart and work your way through 60 hand-made pictures: fruits, animals, sweets, flowers, vehicles and more. Zoom in to reach tiny pixels, zoom out to admire your work, and enjoy the satisfying pop of every painted pixel.

Features:

60 hand-made pixel pictures, with more on the way
Easy one-finger painting, no timers and no pressure
Pinch to zoom and drag to move around the canvas
FIND hint that points you to the next pixel
AUTO fill: a helping hand paints a whole color for you
Collect coins and spend them in the shop
Relaxing music and a satisfying win animation
Your progress is saved automatically

Perfect for a quick break or a long chill session. Can you finish them all?
pk-pixel-paint.controls:
Mobile: Touch and drag to paint. Two-finger pinch to zoom. Drag on empty or wrong pixels to move the canvas.
PC: Click and drag to paint. Mouse wheel to zoom. Drag on a wrong pixel to move the canvas.
Buttons: The fit button resets the zoom, FIND shows the next pixel, AUTO paints the selected color, and the pause button opens the menu.

pk-paintballz-io.title: Paintballz.io
pk-paintballz-io.description:
Paintballz.io is a fast online multiplayer paintball shooter. One paintball is all it takes: there are no health bars, so whoever lands the first hit wins the fight. Paintballs fly as real projectiles that drop over distance, so lead your targets, use cover and outplay the other side.

Jump into a room with up to 18 players and play Team Deathmatch (Blue against Red) or Free for All. Rooms are never empty: bots fill the free spots, and every player who joins takes a bot's place. When a round ends, everyone votes on the next map and the fun keeps going.

Features:
- One-hit tags with real paintball physics: ball speed, drop, spread and range
- Team Deathmatch and Free for All on 5 maps: Classic, House, Warehouse, Proto Yard and Trenches
- 27 paintguns, from rifles and SMGs to shotguns, miniguns and snipers with scopes, unlocked with the cash you earn by playing
- Kill-streak rewards: Radar, Sentry, Drone, Wall, Tank and Nuke
- Over 100 accessories for your character: hats, masks, backpacks, wings and full outfits
- Daily tasks, daily login rewards and 100 levels to climb
- Play with friends: parties, private rooms and invite links
- Servers around the world: the game picks the closest one, or choose your own
- A quick tutorial for new players, so you can start tagging in under a minute
- Your progress is saved to your CrazyGames account
pk-paintballz-io.controls:
WASD or arrow keys: move
Mouse: look and aim
Left mouse button: shoot (hold for automatic guns)
Right mouse button (hold) or E: aim / scope
Space: jump (after you're tagged: respawn sooner)
Z, X, C, V: use kill-streak rewards
1: back to your gun
Enter or T: chat
Tab (hold): scoreboard
M: mute
Esc or P: pause
K: skip the tutorial
All keys except Esc can be changed in Settings.

pk-sealed-fates.title: Sealed Fates
pk-sealed-fates.description:
Sealed Fates is a fantasy card duel where nerve beats luck. Each player brings a deck of 20 and plays one card a turn onto the Pile. Your card's Attack has to reach the top card's Defence. Can't beat it, or would rather not? Take the Pile into your hand and plan your comeback. The first player to get rid of every card wins.

Gods are infinite, and only infinity beats them. Worlds and Spells go on anything, and while a World is in play it powers up its whole element and beats the rival one, so a single card can turn a match around. When your deck runs dry you play your three Guardians, and last of all you flip your three Sealed cards blind.

WHAT YOU CAN PLAY
• Your free Starter Set: six packs to open by hand, with cards for your first decks
• Bots at Easy, Medium and Hard
• Trials of Ny'Vara: six rivals, each with their own deck and a twist on the rules
• Casual online matches and challenges with friends
• A deck builder with a Power budget: mix two elements and find your combos
• 85 cards across Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Light and Dark
• Animated Worlds that set the table on fire, flood it or blow it away

You play as a guest, and your collection is saved in this browser. There are no ads and nothing is for sale. Opening more packs and ranked play need a Google account: sign in on the game's website or in the apps.

HOW IT STARTED
In 2023 I travelled around Europe with friends, and a mate and I played Palace with a normal deck of cards nearly the whole trip. I kept wondering what it would be like as a trading card game, so I made one: I designed the cards and an expansion in Figma, wrote the spells and the lore, and printed the only physical deck. Sealed Fates is the digital version I always wanted, inspired by Hearthstone. It has drifted a little from the printed cards, but it plays the same.

The card illustrations were made with an AI image generator (Microsoft Copilot) and picked by hand; the rules, card frames, effects and sound design are the game's own.
pk-sealed-fates.controls:
Mouse: drag a card up onto the Pile, or click it and then click the Pile. On a wide screen, point at any card to read it in the side panel. Click Take pile to take the Pile.
Keyboard, in a match: 1 to 9 and 0 pick a card in your hand, the Left and Right arrows move the pick, Space or Enter plays it, T takes the Pile, I opens the card, E opens quick chat, Esc steps back, and ? lists every key.
Touch: drag a card up onto the Pile, or tap it and then tap the Pile. Hold any card to read it. Tap Take pile to take the Pile.
Sound and music: Settings, the cog in the top corner.

pk-sheep-climb.title: Sheep Climb
pk-sheep-climb.description:
Sheep Climb is a fast, addictive one-touch climbing game. Guide your fluffy sheep up a twisting staircase in the sky, one hop at a time. Pick the right direction, keep your rhythm and reach the golden finish platform to clear each level!

But watch your step. The higher you climb, the trickier the path gets: cracked blocks crumble under your hooves, spikes pop up, ghost blocks blink in and out, platforms slide and lift, boulders roll down the stairs and blocks flip over without warning. Time your hops, hide on the side ledges and never stop moving!

Collect coins on the way and spend them in the shop to unlock a whole farm of adorable animals, from the classic sheep to a piggy, a panda, a penguin, a unicorn and the legendary Golden Ram. Upgrade your income to earn more coins every run, and watch an ad to multiply your reward.

Features:
- Simple one-touch controls anyone can learn in seconds
- Hundreds of levels that get harder as you climb
- 7 different obstacles, each with its own twist
- 10 collectible animals to unlock
- Colorful, relaxing hyper-casual style with a catchy soundtrack
- Revive and reward multiplier to keep your run going

How high can your sheep climb? Play Sheep Climb now!
pk-sheep-climb.controls:
Mouse: Click and drag left or right, or click the left or right side of the screen.
Keyboard: Left / Right arrow keys or A / D.
Mobile: Swipe left or right, or tap the left or right side of the screen.

pk-3d-plank.title: 3D Plank
pk-3d-plank.description:
3D Plank is a simple, addictive one-tap bridge game. Hold to stretch your plank, release to drop it, and walk across to the next pillar. Make it too short or too long and you fall!

Land the plank right in the middle of a pillar for a PERFECT bonus and build up combos for extra points. Along the way, free the caged animals to earn bonus coins and let them follow you on your journey. Collect coins to unlock a whole crew of blocky characters, from the Birdy and Froggy to the Ninja, Robot, Angel and King.

Every 10 points the world changes with a brand new colorful theme, and the pillars get tougher the further you go. Easy to learn, hard to put down - can you beat your best score?

Features:
- One-tap controls, perfect for quick sessions
- Perfect landings and combo bonuses
- Rescue caged animals and collect coins
- 9 unlockable characters
- Colorful themes that change as you progress
- Watch a video to continue after a fall or multiply your coin reward
pk-3d-plank.controls:
Mouse / Touch: press and hold to grow the plank, release to drop it
Keyboard: hold Space or Up Arrow to grow, release to drop
Pause: P or Esc

pk-gravity-flip.title: Gravity Flip
pk-gravity-flip.description: Gravity Flip is a fast one-tap runner where you control a cube sliding along the floor and ceiling of a neon corridor. Tap to flip gravity, dodge the walls closing in, and grab coins along the way. The corridor gets faster and trickier with every level, and each level changes the colors of the world. When a run ends, spend your coins in the shop on new cubes and glowing trails, or watch a short video to multiply your coin reward with the bonus meter. Play free in your browser at PlayKovo, no download and no sign-up.
pk-gravity-flip.controls:
Mobile: tap anywhere on the screen to flip gravity.
Desktop: click, or press Space, Up Arrow, Down Arrow or Enter to flip gravity.

pk-longcat.title: LongCat
pk-longcat.description:
LongCat is a relaxing yet tricky puzzle game. Swipe to send your cat sliding across the board and fill every empty tile. The cat keeps sliding until it hits a wall or its own tail, and it can never go back over the path it already covered. Plan your route carefully, because one wrong move can leave you with no way forward.

Every level is different and the boards get bigger and harder as you go. Stuck? Watch a short video to undo your last move, or skip a level you can't beat. Finish a level to earn gems and boost them with a lucky multiplier. Spend your gems in the shop on new cat colors and preview each one live while the cat plays.

Features:
- Simple one-finger swipe controls
- Endless levels that get harder
- Fresh cat colors to unlock
- Revive, skip and double-reward options
- Bright, juicy cartoon style
- Works on mobile and desktop
pk-longcat.controls:
Mobile: swipe up, down, left or right to move the cat.
Desktop: arrow keys or WASD to move, Esc to pause, R to restart the level.

pk-blok-cube-jump-adventure.title: BLOK: Cube Jump Adventure
pk-blok-cube-jump-adventure.description:
BLOK is a calm, minimalist physics-skill game about one small cube and a very long way up. You float over a sea of mist, standing on a tall pillar. Somewhere ahead, another pillar waits with a glowing frame on top. Your job is simple: get there.

Pull back on the screen to aim, then let go. The cube launches, tumbles through the air and, if your aim is true, lands on the marked block. Every successful landing scores a point and builds the next pillar in front of you. Land right in the center and you earn a perfect landing: a shockwave ripples out, a bright chord rings and you get a bonus point.

It sounds easy, and for a while it is. Then the world starts pushing back. Platforms shrink and drift farther apart. Some slide up and down, some sway from side to side, and some crumble the moment you land. Stacked blocks make the edges tricky. Tall poles rise between pillars and force you to arc your jump higher, and hanging blocks hover over the gap and demand a low, flat shot. Round, hexagonal and square tops each ask for a slightly different feel. One miss and the run is over, so every jump counts.

As you climb, the scenery changes. BLOK takes you through four hand-tinted worlds: Pink Mist, Frozen Vale, Crimson Realm and Midnight Garden. Colors, fog, background towers and floating dust blend smoothly from one world to the next. Each world has its own mood and its own soft, generative ambient music that never repeats the same way twice. Every landing plays a note from the current world’s scale, so a clean run slowly turns into a little melody.

BLOK is made to be picked up in seconds and played for as long as you like. There is no timer, no energy bar and no rush. Just you, the cube, the mist and the next pillar. Beat your best score, chase perfect landings and see how far you can go.

Features:

Simple one-gesture controls: pull back, aim, release
Round, hexagonal and square platforms
Moving, crumbling and stacked blocks
Wall and hanging-block obstacles that change how you aim
Four themed worlds with smooth color transitions
Relaxing generative music and satisfying sound effects
Perfect-landing bonus with shockwave and chime
Landing, flight-trail and crash effects with gentle camera shake
Best score saved automatically, cloud save supported
Works on phones, tablets and desktop, in Turkish and English
pk-blok-cube-jump-adventure.controls:
Mouse: click and hold, drag backwards, release to jump
Touch: press and hold, drag backwards, lift your finger to jump
Sound button (top right): turn music and effects on or off
Question-mark button (top right): quick how-to-play
Home button (game over screen): back to the main menu

pk-color-fill.title: Color Fill
pk-color-fill.description:
Color Fill is a satisfying 3D puzzle game where your cube paints the whole board.

Slide out onto the grey area, draw a line, then come back to your color to fill everything you closed in. Trap the red blocks inside your paint and they pop. Fill the whole board to finish the level and reveal the picture you painted.

Every level is a new shape, and the challenge keeps growing. Red blocks patrol the board, chasers hunt you down, bouncers ricochet across the grid, and spiky walkers crawl over your own color. Every few levels a giant boss shows up. Trap it again and again until it pops.

FEATURES
- Simple one-finger swipe controls
- Hundreds of levels with multi-stage boards and boss fights
- Collect pink gems on the board to spend in the shop
- Unlock cube colors, hats, wings and colorful trails
- Preview every item live in the shop before you buy
- Quick, relaxing rounds that are easy to learn and hard to put down

Can you fill the whole board without touching a red block? Play Color Fill now!
pk-color-fill.controls:
Mobile: swipe to move the cube.
Desktop: arrow keys or WASD to move. Press Space or Enter to start.

pk-stack-jump.title: Stack Jump
pk-stack-jump.description:
Stack Jump is a one-tap arcade game where you build a tower by jumping onto blocks. Rock blocks slide in from the left and right. Tap at the right moment to jump, and the block stops under your feet. Jump too late and the block knocks you off the tower.

Land a block right in the center to get a PERFECT: +2 points, a star burst and a combo counter. The blocks get faster as your tower grows, and the scenery changes every 15 points, from a starry night to ocean, sunset, aurora and lava skies.

Collect coins after every run and spend them in the shop on 8 character colors and 10 accessories, including a cap, shades, headphones, a top hat, a crown and a halo. Upgrade your coin income, continue a run once by watching an ad, and triple your coins with the x3 claim.

Features:
- Simple one-tap controls
- Perfect landings, combos and increasing speed
- 5 changing sky themes
- 8 characters and 10 accessories to unlock
- Coin income upgrade
- Best score saved automatically
pk-stack-jump.controls:
Mobile: Tap anywhere on the screen to jump.
Desktop: Click, or press Space / Arrow Up to jump.

pk-line-color-3d.title: Line Color 3D
pk-line-color-3d.description:
Line Color 3D is a one-touch skill game about drawing a line through danger. Press and hold to move your pen along a winding white track. Release to stop it. Your line follows the groove, but the track is full of moving obstacles, and a single touch means you start the stretch again.

Spinning bars, sliding blocks, saw blades cutting across the path, swinging hammers, crushing presses, sliding doors and pop-up spikes all move on their own timing. Every level mixes different obstacles, so you never play the same track twice. Watch the pattern, stop at a safe spot and move through the gap at the right moment.

Levels get longer and denser as you go, and the track layout is new each time. Earn coins to upgrade your income, and spend gems in the shop on new line colours and pens, including a duo line and a rainbow line. Missed a jump in timing? Revive and carry on from just before the obstacle.
pk-line-color-3d.controls:
Mouse: hold the left button to draw, release to stop
Touch: hold your finger anywhere on the screen to draw, lift to stop

pk-circle-escape.title: Circle Escape
pk-circle-escape.description:
Circle Escape is a fast, addictive one-tap arcade game. Your ball rolls around a set of spinning rings, and your job is simple: jump over the spikes, find the gap and drop through to the next ring until you escape!

Every level adds more rings, faster speeds and trickier spike patterns, so timing is everything. Collect coins as you fall, upgrade your income, and spend them in the shop to unlock new balls and cool trail effects like sparkles, hearts, flames, snow and rainbow.

Features:
- Simple one-tap controls
- Hundreds of levels that keep getting harder
- Unlockable balls and trail effects
- Coin rewards and income upgrades
- Smooth, colorful hyper-casual style
- Play anywhere, on mobile or desktop

Can you escape every circle?
pk-circle-escape.controls:
Mobile: Tap the screen to jump.
Desktop: Click the mouse, or press Space, Enter or the Up Arrow to jump.
Pause: Use the pause button at the top left.

pk-line-zen.title: Line Zen
pk-line-zen.description:
Line Zen is a relaxing but addictive one-finger arcade game. Guide your ball down an endless, winding road without touching the walls. The path twists, narrows and zigzags, and the farther you go, the faster and trickier it gets.

Dodge sharp spikes, slip past sliding blocks, spinning bars, pulsing orbs and tight tunnels. Collect coins along the way and spend them in the shop to unlock new balls, glowing trails and colorful themes. The sky changes color every 100 points, so every run feels fresh.

Features:
- Simple one-finger controls, easy to learn and hard to master
- Endless levels that never repeat the same way twice
- Moving obstacles, spikes, narrow tunnels and wavy roads
- 9 balls, 8 trails and 6 themes to unlock
- Watch an ad to continue your run or earn bonus coins
- Chill music and satisfying sound effects
- Works on phones, tablets and computers

How far can you go? Stay calm, stay on the line and beat your best score!
pk-line-zen.controls:
Mobile: Touch and drag left or right to steer.
PC: Move the mouse left or right to steer. Press Esc, P or Space to pause.

pk-triple-hop.title: Triple Hop
pk-triple-hop.description:
Triple Hop is a fast, colorful one-tap runner where every jump counts. Your ball rolls down a glowing ramp full of spikes, spinning saws, deadly gaps and moving traps. Time your taps, jump up to 3 times in mid-air and see how far you can go!

Skim just over an obstacle to land a PERFECT near miss. Chain them for big combos, fill the FEVER bar and go wild: in FEVER mode you smash through spikes and saws, fly over gaps and pull in coins like a magnet.

Features:
- Simple one-tap controls, easy to learn and hard to put down
- Triple jump: two extra jumps in mid-air
- Near-miss combos, PERFECT bonuses and FEVER mode
- Bouncy jump pads, moving spikes, rolling saws and hidden traps
- The world changes color and speeds up as you score
- Collect coins and unlock 12 balls and 8 colorful trails
- Upgrade your FEVER time and your coin income
- Watch an optional ad to continue your run or grab free coins
- Cheerful music, juicy effects and smooth animations

How far can you hop? Beat your best score and become the Triple Hop champion!
pk-triple-hop.controls:
Mobile: Tap the screen to jump (tap again in the air for double and triple jump). Keep your phone in portrait mode.
Desktop: Click, Space or Up Arrow to jump. Esc to pause.

pk-moxstrike.title: MOXstrike
pk-moxstrike.description:
MOXstrike: Neon Voxel Warfare
Gear up and enter a blocky battlefield glowing with neon. MOXstrike is a fast-paced first-person shooter built for quick, satisfying fights: aim, fire, move, and switch weapons as you take on the enemy.

Its voxel style gives the action a bold retro look, while the futuristic setting brings plenty of electric color and combat energy. Play on desktop or mobile, with touch controls designed to keep you moving and shooting.

Lock on. Load up. Strike first.
pk-moxstrike.controls:
Desktop
- W, A, S, D — Move
- Mouse — Aim and look around
- Clicking — Shooting
- Weapon button — Switch guns
-SWIFT button — Sprint
Mobile
- Use the W, A, and D buttons to move.
- Tap the screen to shoot. Move camera by dragging.
- Tap the weapon button to switch guns.

pk-sky-hop.title: Sky Hop
pk-sky-hop.description:
Sky Hop is a one-tap flying game. Your bird keeps falling, and every tap makes it flap upward. Guide it through the gaps between the pillars without touching them or the ground.

Every pillar you pass gives you one point. The sky changes every 10 points, going from a sunny meadow to sunset, candy land, a starry night and a snowy day. As your score grows the game speeds up, the gaps get tighter, and from 25 points some pillars start moving up and down.

Coins float between the pillars. Collect them and spend them in the Skins shop on nine birds: Chick, Bluey, Pinky, Froggy, Cool, Sporty, Angel, Devil and King. You can also unlock a skin by watching two short ads. After a crash you can watch an ad to continue your run once, or double the coins you earned.

Your best score, coins and unlocked birds are saved automatically. Sky Hop runs in your browser on phone and desktop, with no download and no sign-up.
pk-sky-hop.controls:
Mouse / Touch: click or tap anywhere to flap
Keyboard: Space or Up Arrow to flap

pk-cube-slide-merge.title: Cube Slide Merge
pk-cube-slide-merge.description:
Cube Slide Merge is a number puzzle where every move counts. Swipe in any direction and all the cubes on the board slide together until they hit a wall or another cube. When two cubes with the same number meet, they merge into a single cube with the next number up. Clear the board down to one cube to finish the level.

The boards are never the same. Some are plain rectangles, others are shaped like letters, staircases or boards with holes, so a slide that works in one corner can wreck your plan in another. You cannot move a single cube on its own, which means you have to plan how the whole group will travel before you swipe.

Every level is generated so that it can be solved, and the levels keep going with bigger boards and more cubes as you progress. Finishing a level in few moves earns up to three stars and more coins.

Stuck? Undo your last move as often as you like, or use a hint to see the next swipe. Spend your coins in the shop on new cube color sets and board themes to change how the game looks.
pk-cube-slide-merge.controls: Mouse / touch: swipe or drag in the direction you want the cubes to slide. Keyboard: arrow keys or W A S D to slide, Z or Backspace to undo. Use the buttons at the bottom for hint and undo.

pk-moxride.title: MoxRide
pk-moxride.description: MoxRide throws you straight into a downhill skateboarding race where speed, tricks, and a bit of recklessness are all part of the fun. Grind rails, pull off wild combos, leap between obstacles, and try to outskate the competition while racking up ridiculous scores. There's always a better line to take, a bigger trick to land, or a high score waiting to be smashed. It's fast, chaotic, and ridiculously easy to get hooked on.
pk-moxride.controls:
WASD for moving in all cardinal directions. SPACEBAR for jumping/olleying.
The buttons: ZXCVBNM, are each a different trick, for you to enjoy.

pk-moxriding.title: MoxRiding
pk-moxriding.description: MoxRiding turns skateboarding into a fast-paced game of skill, timing, and strategy! Chain tricks into massive combos, then carefully roll straight to bank your points before risking it all on another trick. With a global TOP 10 leaderboard, every run is a chance to make skateboarding history. Easy to learn, challenging to master, and endlessly replayable!

pk-knife-climb-tower.title: Knife Climb Tower
pk-knife-climb-tower.description: Knife Climb Tower is a one-tap climbing game. A ball bounces at a steady height next to a tall tower, and every tap throws a knife into the next slot. Your knives stay in the wall and become the steps you climb. Throw too early and the knife hits the ball and pops it. The top three knives fall away and you restart three steps lower. Throw at the right moment, just as the falling ball is above the new slot, and it lands on the fresh knife for a PERFECT bounce that carries you several steps up. As you progress, steel bands force you to skip a knife, cracked slots break after a few landings, and every fifth level is a taller boss tower. Collect coins along the way and spend them in the shop on new balls, knives and tower themes.
pk-knife-climb-tower.controls: Tap or click anywhere on the screen to throw a knife. On a computer you can also press Space or the Up Arrow.

pk-hexa-go.title: Hexa Go
pk-hexa-go.description: Hexa Go is a satisfying hex puzzle. Every tile has an arrow, and tapping a tile sends it sliding off the board the way its arrow points. Clear a path first: if another tile is in the way, your tile crashes and you lose a heart. Levels start flat and grow into stacked boards two, three and four layers high, with immovable stones and odd-shaped boards to plan around. Turn the board to see every arrow, zoom in for the tricky spots, and use the Hint and Rotate boosters when you get stuck. Rotate lets you turn a single tile's arrow toward a clear way out. Collect gems, unlock new tile styles, and see how far you can go.
pk-hexa-go.controls: Mouse / touch: tap a tile to send it. Drag (or swipe in a circle around the board) to turn the board. Mouse wheel / two-finger pinch: zoom. Keyboard: H = hint, T = rotate booster, Q / E = turn the board, R = restart.

pk-helix-snake.title: Helix Snake
pk-helix-snake.description:
Helix Snake is a colorful, fast-paced arcade runner where you steer a snake down an endless twisting tube. Eat bouncy candy to grow longer, then dive through the ring blocks - but every block has a number, and it eats away your length! Always aim for the lowest number to keep your snake long, and watch the numbers climb from single digits to thousands and even millions the further you go.

Dodge red spikes, spinning bars and buzz saws, grab turbo pads to smash through whole rings, chain candy for a FEVER boost and collect gems to unlock new snake skins and funny hats in the shop. Run through five beautiful worlds - Candy, Beach, Autumn, Winter and Night - with falling leaves, snow, stars and super-fast speed lines.

Simple one-finger controls, juicy effects and satisfying crunches make every run feel great. How long can your snake get?
pk-helix-snake.controls:
On Desktop
Mouse
- Hold left mouse button and drag = steer
- Right mouse button = speed boost

Keyboard
- A and D / Left and Right Arrow keys = steer
- W / Up Arrow key = speed boost

On Mobile and Tablet
- Slide your finger = steer
- Double tap / touch with a second finger = speed boost

pk-sketch-brawl.title: Sketch Brawl
pk-sketch-brawl.description:
Sketch Brawl is a hand-drawn stickman fighting game that looks like it jumped straight out of a comic book. Every punch lands with a POW, every kick with a BAM, and every throw ends in a ground-shaking SLAM!

FIGHT YOUR WAY ACROSS 4 REGIONS
Start in Sketchbook Valley and battle through the Ink Docks, Crayon City and Shredder Peak. Each region has 7 rivals with their own looks and fighting styles, plus a giant boss waiting at the end. Beat the boss to unlock the next region – and watch out, every region hits harder than the last.

4 BOSSES, 4 SPECIAL ATTACKS
- The Eraser vanishes into dust and reappears right behind you.
- Capt. Inkbeard hurls ink bombs that blind and slow you down.
- Marker Max slams the ground and sends shockwaves rolling across the arena – jump or get launched!
- The Shredder spins into a whirlwind of rapid hits.
Push a boss below 40% health and it flies into a RAGE: stronger hits, faster specials, burning aura.

DEEP BUT EASY-TO-LEARN COMBAT
Chain punches and kicks into combos, launch rivals into the air with an uppercut, sweep their legs, grab them and slam them into the ground, or block at the right moment and counter. Fill your super meter and unleash a cinematic SUPER attack. Throws beat blocks, jumps beat sweeps – every fight is a little mind game.

REAL COMIC-BOOK STYLE
Paper textures, halftone dots, ink splatters, impact stars, slow-motion K.O.s, screen shake and big comic sound words make every hit feel amazing. Switch to Night mode for a moody chalkboard look.

SHOP & CUSTOMIZATION
Earn coins and XP from every fight, level up and spend your coins in the shop: new skin colors (including Rainbow), headgear like crowns, top hats, horns and halos, and slash effects such as Inferno, Frost and Golden Slash.

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
- Training: learn every move step by step against a practice dummy.
- 2 Players: fight a friend side by side on one keyboard (desktop).
- Daily gift: come back every day for free coins.

Your progress is saved automatically and synced to your PlayKovo account. Grab your pencil, tie your headband and start the brawl!
pk-sketch-brawl.controls:
Keyboard (Player 1):
A / D – Walk left / right
W – Jump
S – Block (hold)
J – Punch (press repeatedly to combo)
K – Kick
S + K – Sweep (low kick that knocks down)
L – Uppercut (launches the opponent)
U – Grab & Throw (beats blocking)
I – Super attack (when the meter is full)
Double-tap A or D – Dash
Esc or P – Pause

Player 2 (2 Players mode, same keyboard):
Arrow keys – Walk / Jump / Block
, – Punch   . – Kick   / – Uppercut   ; – Throw   ' – Super

Mobile / Touch:
Joystick – Move (up = jump, down = block)
PUNCH / KICK / GRAB buttons – Attack
Joystick down + PUNCH – Uppercut
Joystick down + KICK – Sweep
SUPER button – Appears when the meter is full

pk-class-seat-jam.title: Class Seat Jam
pk-class-seat-jam.description:
Class Seat Jam is a 3D seat puzzle set in a busy school. Every student is sitting in the wrong seat, and it is your job to get each one back where they belong before the clock runs out.

Tap a student and they run straight to their own seat, as long as the way is clear. Seated students and desks block the path, so the order of your moves matters: send the wrong student first and someone gets trapped. Every student wears a tag with their seat code, like B2 for column B, row 2, and the seat letters and numbers are painted on the classroom walls.

The school grows as you play. You start in a single classroom, then move to hallways with several classes, then to a school yard where students cross between buildings, and finally to a full campus. In bigger maps the tag also shows the class, such as 5-A or 5-C, and each class has its own badge so you always know where to go. From level 8, sleepy students join in: tap once to wake them up, then again to send them to their seat.

When you get stuck, boosters help: undo your last move, get a hint for a safe next move, send a blocking student home, or add 30 seconds to the clock. Earn coins for every student you seat and every level you clear, open a reward chest every 5 levels, collect a daily gift, and spend your coins on hats for the students and new seat styles.

100 levels mix easy, normal and hard puzzles, and every level can be solved.
pk-class-seat-jam.controls: Tap or click a student to send them to their seat. Drag to move the view, and pinch or use the mouse wheel to zoom. Tap the booster buttons to undo, get a hint, remove a student or add time.

pk-tower-clash.title: Tower Clash
pk-tower-clash.description:
Tower Clash is a 3D tower strategy game played in portrait mode. You start with one blue tower and a small army. Drag from your tower to a connected tower and your soldiers march down the road toward it. When they reach an enemy or neutral tower, each soldier removes one troop. When the count drops below zero, the tower becomes yours.

Every tower grows troops over time. Bigger towers grow faster, get more floors and can send soldiers along more roads at once: one road at the start, up to three at higher tiers. You can also send soldiers through your own towers to reach a tower further away. Swipe across a road to stop sending.

Rival armies play at the same time. Soldiers from different teams meeting on the same road fight each other. From level 4, some roads are blocked by brick walls with a health bar, and every soldier that hits a wall lowers its health by one until it breaks.

The game has levels without an end. Maps get bigger as you progress: one rival at the start, then two, three and four. The world changes every 5 levels: Green Meadow, River Bend, Sunny Beach, Mountain Valley, Frozen Peaks, Desert Canyon, Autumn Woods and Lava Island.

Use coins to upgrade your starting army, troop growth and soldier speed. During a level you can use three boosts: Rush makes your soldiers faster, +10 adds troops to all your towers and Freeze stops enemy armies for a few seconds.
pk-tower-clash.controls: Mouse / touch: drag from your tower to another tower to send soldiers. Swipe across a road to cut it. Tap the boost buttons to use Rush, +10 or Freeze. Tap the pause button to pause the game.

pk-cube-rush-merge-2048.title: Cube Rush: Merge 2048
pk-cube-rush-merge-2048.description:
Cube Rush: Merge 2048 is a physics merge puzzle. Drag along the launch line, release to shoot a numbered cube into the tray, and watch matching cubes collide and combine into the next number: 2 and 2 make 4, 4 and 4 make 8, all the way up to 2048 and beyond.

Every level gives you a target tile and a limited number of shots, so each throw has to count. Chain several merges in a row to trigger combos that pay out extra coins. Run out of room and the cubes cross the red line, so keep the tray clear.

The game runs through four worlds. The meadow teaches the basics with pillars, barricades and ramps. Later worlds add moving blocks, fans that lift cubes, ice patches, trampolines, pinball bumpers, x2 gates that double a cube's value, spinning sweepers, black holes that swallow small cubes, and portals that teleport your shot to another part of the tray. Some space levels split the tray in two boards and lower the gravity.

Use coins to buy Undo and Bomb boosts, and to unlock new cube skins, tray shapes, floors and backgrounds in the shop. Endless mode removes the shot limit and keeps raising the goal tile for as long as you can hold the board.
pk-cube-rush-merge-2048.controls: Mouse / Touch: press and drag to aim, release to shoot. Tap the Undo and Bomb buttons to use boosts. Tap the speaker icon on the start screen to mute or unmute.

pk-fire-rush-3d.title: Fire Rush 3D
pk-fire-rush-3d.description:
Fire Rush 3D is a fast, colourful shooting runner. Sprint down a winding road, pick the right gates to grow your ammo, and let your hero fire automatically at everything in the way.

Every bullet counts. Your ammo is your power: shoot brick walls, barrels and crates to clear the path and win more ammo, face armed enemy squads in a stand-off, and take down bosses that call for backup and fly into a rage. Some gates can even be shot to raise their numbers.

But watch out! Spikes, laser grids, spinning arms, mine fields, flamethrowers, bomb strikes, a wrecking ball and rolling boulders will knock you out if you touch them, so keep your eyes on the road.

At the end, smash the giant spinning Fire Balls tower. Every floor rotates the other way and black pieces bounce your shots back, so aim well and keep enough ammo to bring it all down.

Win coins and diamonds, upgrade your ammo and income, unlock guns and outfits in the shop, and play to earn free VIP gifts every day for a week: new weapons and characters that make you stronger.

Five worlds to run through: Army Base, Volcano Isle, Snow Fort, Pirate Cove and Jungle Ruins. No download and no sign-up, play free in your browser.
pk-fire-rush-3d.controls:
Mouse / touch: hold and drag to steer, tap to fire faster, hold to fire at the tower
Keyboard: Left / Right arrows or A / D to steer, Space to fire at the tower

pk-twisty-io.title: Twisty.io
pk-twisty-io.description:
Twisty.io is a fast, free 3D snake battle. Slither around a colorful arena, eat glowing candy to grow longer, and outsmart a crowd of rival snakes. Boost past your opponents, cut them off and make them crash into your body to turn them into a feast of food.

Earn coins every round and spend them in the shop on skins and trail effects. Collect common, rare and gold looks, or watch short ads to unlock exclusive VIP and VIP+ skins. Choose your arena or play a random one: Meadow, Beach, Snow, Sunset and Night.
pk-twisty-io.controls:
Desktop: Move the mouse to steer. Click and hold or press Space to boost.
Mobile: Use the joystick on the left to steer. Hold the BOOST button on the right to speed up.

pk-muscle-run.title: Muscle Run
pk-muscle-run.description:
Muscle Run is a fast, funny runner where you build the biggest muscles on the track!

Dash down the road and pick the best gate: x2, +50, -10, ÷2. Your muscles grow or shrink with every choice. Grab protein like eggs and steak to bulk up, but watch out for donuts and cake. They give you a belly!

Stop at the gym stations on the way. Do pull-ups, push-ups, sit-ups and heavy barbell lifts to pump up even more. The heavier the set, the bigger the reward, but you need enough strength to finish it.

Fight rival muscle men. Tap fast to land extra punches and knock them flat. Dodge saws, rolling barrels, crushing presses, bridge gaps, treadmills and swinging punching bags.

At the end of every level, grab the hammer and hit the high striker. Time your swing and send the puck up a 100 m tower to ring the bells: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum and the legendary Summit bell. The higher you climb each level, the higher you can reach!

Chain good choices to build a combo and earn bonus power.

Customize your hero in the shop: ready-made outfits (Boxer, Karate Master, Ninja, Muay Thai, Street Brawler, Samurai), tattoos, hair, beards, glasses, hats, gloves, hammers and cool trails. Upgrade your starting power and income, collect diamonds and claim your daily gift.

Five colorful worlds, simple one-finger controls and a hundred levels to the summit. Can you pump all the way to the top?
pk-muscle-run.controls:
Mobile: touch, hold and drag to steer. Tap to punch during fights and to swing the hammer.
Desktop: Mouse drag, or Left / Right arrow keys or A / D to steer. Click or press Space / Enter to punch and to swing the hammer.

pk-idol-run.title: Idol Run
pk-idol-run.description:
Idol Run is a runner where you play a rising pop idol. Run down a floating stage road, collect fans and build your crowd before the big concert.

Fan groups wait along the road. Run into one and they join your idol. Fan gates change your crowd with plus, minus, times and divide values, so pick the good side. Haters hold up BOO signs and make you lose fans, and obstacles such as soda spills, ketchup stands, foam parties, glitter cannons, paparazzi flashes and rolling speakers get in the way.

Style gates let you choose a top, skirt, shoes, hair or accessory. Pieces that match the level's theme score more with the jury. Two rivals, Mia and Zoe, collect fans on the same road, so you race them to the finish.

At the end of each level you walk to a concert stage. The judges hold up cards, your fans cheer, and your final score decides your coin reward.

The game has five worlds: Ocean, Sky, Desert, Miami and Candy, each with giant props like a rubber duck, hot air balloons, cacti, flamingos and lollipops. Spend coins and gems in the shop on hair colours and styles, hats, glasses, shirts, pop effects and trails. Upgrade your starting crowd and income, and your progress is saved.
pk-idol-run.controls:
Mobile: touch, hold and drag left or right.
Desktop: mouse hold and drag, or the left and right arrow keys / A and D.

pk-twist-roll.title: Twist Roll
pk-twist-roll.description:
Twist Roll is a one-touch 3D arcade game. A ball rolls forward on its own along a long pole, and rings and wedges of obstacles block the way. You cannot steer the ball: you twist the pole so that the gap in each obstacle lines up with the ball. Hit an obstacle and the run is over.

Levels get longer and faster as you progress. Early levels open with simple single wedges and wide gates. Later levels add double obstacles on opposite sides, spinning obstacles whose gap keeps moving, and stairs of gates that step around the pole. Every fifth level is a boss level, and each level ends at a finish ring.

Collect coins that sit on the pole between obstacles. After a win you can spin the bonus bar for a multiplier from x2 to x5 on your reward. Spend your coins in the shop on nine ball skins, some with colourful trails, and six themes with their own sky and obstacle colours.
pk-twist-roll.controls: Mouse or touch: press and drag left or right to twist the pole. Keyboard: A / D or Left / Right arrow keys.

pk-dress-up-run.title: Dress Up Run
pk-dress-up-run.description:
Dress Up Run is a 3D runner about style. Every level has a theme: Party, Beach, Princess, Sporty or Gala. On the way you run through five style gates, one each for top, skirt, shoes, hair and accessory. Each gate shows two pieces side by side, and only one of them fits the theme. Pick the right one to earn more style points; a piece from a related theme still scores half.

Collect perfume, lipstick and diamonds on the road for extra points. Watch out for mud puddles, sticky swamp, paint cannons, water sprinklers and the makeup brush. Every stain pulls your score down, but a shower gate later on can wash the mess off. Two rivals, Mia and Zoe, run the same course, choose their own outfits and get splashed too, so you can see who is ahead in the live ranking.

Each level ends on a catwalk where three judges score your look. A clean outfit that fits the theme beats a muddy one. Earn coins and gems, buy new hair colours in the shop, change your look, and claim the daily gift.
pk-dress-up-run.controls: Mouse or touch: hold and drag left or right to steer. Keyboard: A / D or Left / Right arrow keys.

pk-giant-rush.title: Giant Rush
pk-giant-rush.description: Red gangs try to stop you. Run into them and your giant fights them hand to hand until none are left. Brick walls block the road, and only a big enough giant can break through, punching or kicking them to pieces. Along the way you dodge fire jets, swinging axes, saw blades, hammers, wrecking balls, crushers, rolling logs, laser gates and spinners. Every level adds something new, and every level ends with a fight against the giant king. Bring a big enough crowd to win.
pk-giant-rush.controls: Mouse or touch: hold and drag left or right to steer. Keyboard: A / D or Left / Right arrow keys.

pk-crowd-rush-3d.title: Crowd Rush 3D
pk-crowd-rush-3d.description:
Crowd Rush 3D is a colorful crowd runner where one little stickman turns into an army. Steer your runner down a floating track and pick the right math gates: +25, x2 and x3 grow your crowd, while -15 and ÷2 cut it down. Every choice changes your count, so think fast and go for the gate that gives you the most runners.

The road is full of traps that get wilder as you progress: spike fields, saw blades, smash hammers, wrecking balls, spinning bars, broken bridges and moving bonus gates. Squeeze your crowd past them and save as many runners as you can. Red rival crowds wait on the track and some even charge at you, and when two crowds collide every runner trades one for one, so only the bigger crowd survives.

Every fifth level ends with a giant king. Your crowd surrounds him and fights until his number drops to zero, so bring more runners than his health to win. On normal levels your crowd climbs the multiplier stairs at the finish, and the higher you get, the bigger your reward, up to x5.

Collect coins and gems along the way, upgrade your starting crowd and income, and unlock new skins and outfits in the shop. Race through 10 worlds including Ocean Run, Candy Town, Desert Dunes, Snow Peaks, Jungle Rush and Lava Land, and claim a free gift every day.
pk-crowd-rush-3d.controls:
Mouse: click and drag left/right to steer
Touch: tap and drag left/right to steer
Keyboard: Left/Right arrow keys or A/D to steer

pk-orbit-keeper.title: Orbit Keeper
pk-orbit-keeper.description: Orbit Keeper is a fast one-tap reflex game. A dot races around a circle while a big purple arc spins after it, changing direction, speeding up and sometimes lunging straight at you. Tap to flip the dot's direction and keep it away from the arc. Every tap scores a point, so time your flips, stay calm and push your best score higher. The arc gets faster and smarter the longer you survive, and it glows right before it dashes, so watch closely. Grab coins on the safe side of the ring and unlock glossy new dots like Gold, Fire, Galaxy and Rainbow, plus colorful themes like Mint, Sky, Peach and Night. Play Classic, take on the faster Big Arc mode, or collect as many coins as you can in the 60-second Coin Rush.
pk-orbit-keeper.controls: Mouse: click anywhere to flip the dot's direction. Keyboard: press Space, Enter or Up Arrow to flip. Touch: tap anywhere on the screen to flip.

pk-hexa-stack-3d.title: Hexa Stack 3D
pk-hexa-stack-3d.description: Hexa Stack 3D is a satisfying hexa sort puzzle played on a 3D hexagon board you can spin around. Drag stacks of colorful hex tiles from your tray onto empty cells. When neighboring stacks share the same top color, the tiles flip over and slide together. Build a stack of 10 tiles of one color and it pops! Chain merges into big combos, unlock locked cells as you collect tiles, and reach each level's goal before the board fills up. Travel through named chapters like Candy Valley, Honey Hills and Ocean Bay, earn up to 3 stars on every level, and open chapter chests for big rewards. Claim daily rewards, spin the Lucky Wheel, use Hammer and Shuffle boosters when you get stuck, and unlock colorful tile themes like Neon, Ocean, Sunset and Jewel.
pk-hexa-stack-3d.controls: Mouse: click and drag a stack onto the board, drag empty space to rotate the board. Touch: drag a stack with your finger onto the board, swipe empty space to rotate. Tap the Hammer, then tap a stack to smash it. Tap Shuffle to replace your tray stacks.

pk-arrow-blocks-tap-away-block.title: Arrow Blocks: Tap Away Block
pk-arrow-blocks-tap-away-block.description:
Arrow Blocks is a relaxing tap away block puzzle you can play free online, no download needed. Every level is a colorful pixel art picture made of blocks, and every block has an arrow. Tap a block and it slides out the way its arrow points, but only if its path is clear! Hit another block and you lose a heart.

Look closely, plan your moves and find the right order to clear the whole picture before time runs out. Clear hearts, strawberries, mushrooms, cats, coffee cups, rockets, flowers and more across 100 levels that grow from small, easy pictures into big brain teasers.

Stuck? Use a Hint to see a block that can go, or grab an extra heart. Clear levels with all 3 hearts to earn 3 stars, collect coins and gift boxes, and unlock new block styles and cute themes in the shop.

• 100 pixel art puzzle levels, plus endless bonus levels
• Simple one-tap controls, satisfying block-clearing logic
• 14 cute pictures: heart, strawberry, mushroom, cat, cup, rocket and more
• Hearts and a timer for a fun challenge
• Hints and extra hearts when you need help
• Collect stars, coins and gift boxes
• Unlock block styles: Pastel, Rainbow, Neon, Golden
• Cute themes: Sky Party, Bubble Pop, Candy Hearts, Clean White
• Works on phone, tablet and PC, right in your browser

If you like tap away, arrow out or block escape puzzles, you'll love Arrow Blocks!
pk-arrow-blocks-tap-away-block.controls:
Mobile / Tablet: Tap a block to make it slide out
PC: Click a block to make it slide out

pk-arrow-escape-tap-away-arrows.title: Arrow Escape: Tap Away Arrows Puzzle
pk-arrow-escape-tap-away-arrows.description:
Arrow Escape is a relaxing tap away arrows puzzle you can play free online, no download needed. Every arrow is a winding line on the board. Tap one and it slides out the way it points, but only if its path is clear! Hit another arrow and you lose a heart.

Look closely, plan your moves and find the right order to clear every arrow before time runs out. Start with small, easy boards and work your way up to big, twisty mazes across 100 levels.

Stuck? Use a Hint to see an arrow that can go, or grab an extra heart. Clear levels with all 3 hearts to earn 3 stars, collect coins and gifts, and unlock colorful arrow styles and cute themes in the shop.

• 100 brain-teasing levels, plus endless bonus levels
• Simple one-tap controls, deep logic puzzles
• Hearts and a timer for a fun challenge
• Hints and extra hearts when you need help
• Collect stars, coins and gift boxes
• Unlock arrow styles: Candy Pop, Rainbow, Neon Glow, Golden
• Cute themes: Sky Party, Bubble Pop, Candy Hearts, Clean White
• Works on phone, tablet and PC, right in your browser

If you like arrows puzzle escape, arrow out or tap away games, you’ll love Arrow Escape!
pk-arrow-escape-tap-away-arrows.controls:
Mobile / Tablet: Tap an arrow to make it slide out
PC: Click an arrow to make it slide out

pk-donut-sort-color-stacking-puz.title: Donut Sort: Color Stacking Puzzle
pk-donut-sort-color-stacking-puz.description:
Donut Sort is a cozy color sorting puzzle game you can play free online, no download needed. Tap a stick to lift the top donuts, then tap another stick to drop them. Stack every flavor onto its own stick to clear the level!

Start with easy puzzles and work your way up through 100 levels of sweet brain teasers. Watch out for mystery “?” donuts that only show their flavor once they reach the top, and bigger sticks that hold 5 donuts in later levels.

Stuck on a tricky level? Use Undo, get a Hint that shows the best move, or add an extra stick. Earn coins and 3 stars on every level, then unlock new sticks, donut flavors and cozy rooms in the shop.

• 100 relaxing color sort puzzle levels, plus endless bonus levels
• Cute 3D donuts with glossy icing and sprinkles
• Mystery donuts and bigger sticks for extra challenge
• Undo, Hints and Extra Stick boosters
• Collect stars and unlock sticks, flavors and rooms
• No timer, no pressure: play at your own pace
• Works on phone, tablet and PC, right in your browser

If you like nut sort, water sort or ball sort games, you’ll love this sweet donut stacking puzzle!
pk-donut-sort-color-stacking-puz.controls:
Mobile / Tablet: Tap a stick to pick up donuts · Tap another stick to drop them
PC: Click a stick to pick up donuts · Click another stick to drop them · Number keys 1-9 select sticks · Ctrl+Z Undo · H Hint · R Restart · Esc Menu

pk-cosmic-clicker-idle-tycoon.title: Cosmic Clicker – Idle Tycoon
pk-cosmic-clicker-idle-tycoon.description:
Cosmic Clicker is a relaxing space idle clicker game. Tap the planet to make energy, then spend it on buildings that produce energy for you every second – even while you are away!

Start on Earth with a humble campfire and grow all the way to a Dyson Sphere around the Sun. Every planet you unlock – Moon, Mars, Venus, Jupiter, Saturn, Neptune and the Sun – brings six new, more powerful buildings. Buy tap upgrades to multiply your click power and watch the numbers climb from thousands to millions, billions, trillions and beyond.

When you are ready, go Supernova: blow up your solar system and start again with Stardust that permanently boosts everything you make.

Features:
• Simple, satisfying tap-to-earn gameplay
• 8 beautiful spinning pixel planets to unlock
• 48 buildings that make energy every second
• 10 tap upgrades that double your click power
• Offline earnings – your planets keep working while you are away
• Supernova prestige with permanent Stardust bonuses
• Free boosts: x5 tap power, auto tapper, double energy and free energy
• Your progress is saved automatically
• Free to play in your browser on phone, tablet and PC
pk-cosmic-clicker-idle-tycoon.controls:
Mobile & Tablet:
• Tap the planet – collect energy
• ‹ › – switch planets
• SHOP – buy buildings, tap upgrades and boosts

Desktop:
• Click the planet – collect energy
• ‹ › – switch planets
• SHOP – buy buildings, tap upgrades and boosts

pk-state-clash-conquer-the-map.title: State Clash – Conquer the Map
pk-state-clash-conquer-the-map.description:
State Clash is a fast, addictive map conquest strategy game – an io-style territory war you can play free online in your browser, with no download. Start with a single state, build up your army and send your soldiers to capture neighbouring regions until the whole map wears your colour.

Every state has a base that trains soldiers over time. Drag from your base to any other state to march your troops: reinforce your own land, take over neutral grey states, or attack rival armies. If you arrive with more soldiers than the defenders, the state is yours! Rival armies that meet on the road clash and wipe each other out, so timing and smart attacks matter more than speed.

Battle through a 60-level campaign. The first levels are a calm 1v1, then rival nations join in – 2, 3 and finally 4 enemies fighting for the same map. Golden star states train soldiers twice as fast, so grab them early. Earn coins with every victory and unlock team colors and permanent upgrades to grow your empire faster.

Features:
• Simple drag-to-attack controls – easy to learn, hard to master
• 60 levels of territory war with smarter, bolder rivals
• Capture neutral states, defend your borders, outsmart up to 4 enemy armies
• Star states with double soldier production
• Permanent upgrades: Recruiting, Big Army, Fast March, Strong Walls
• 8 team colors to unlock
• Short 1–3 minute battles – perfect for quick play
• Works on phone, tablet, laptop and PC – free, no download, play instantly

If you love state io games, Risk-style board strategy, territory war and map takeover games, State Clash is your next favourite conquer-the-world game.
pk-state-clash-conquer-the-map.controls:
Mobile & Tablet:
• Drag from your state to another state – send soldiers
• Tap your state, then tap a target – send soldiers
• Pause button (top left) – pause the game

Desktop:
• Click and drag from your state to another state – send soldiers
• Click your state, then click a target – send soldiers
• Esc / P – pause

pk-block-bash.title: Block Bash
pk-block-bash.description:
Block Bash is a fast, colorful voxel .io game where you play as a little block head in a big 3D arena. Gobble up gold and diamond blocks to grow bigger, then smash into other heads to knock blocks out of them – every bump costs both heads health, but the bigger head always hits harder!

When a head runs out of health it bursts into a shower of blocks for everyone to grab. Climb the leaderboard, outsmart 20 hungry rivals and grab potions at the right moment: speed to escape, healing to survive or a shield to bash without taking damage.

Features:
• Simple, addictive .io gameplay – eat, grow, bash
• Bump combat: both heads lose health, the bigger head hits harder
• Defeated heads burst into blocks you can collect
• Speed, heal and shield potions
• 10 arenas – a new one every round
• 8 original voxel heads: Bruno Bear, Panda, Froggo, Bolt-O, Shadow, Jack, Stripes and Gold King
• Colorful trails: sparkles, fire, hearts, rainbow and more
• Permanent upgrades: Head Start, Tough Head, Quick Feet, Gold Magnet, Long Potions
• Live leaderboard with 20 bots – no waiting for players
• Plays great on phone, tablet and desktop – free in your browser, no download
pk-block-bash.controls:
Desktop:
• Mouse – move toward the cursor
• WASD / Arrow Keys – move
• Esc – back to menu

Mobile:
• Drag anywhere on the screen – move (virtual joystick)

pk-hex-drop-io.title: Hex Drop.io
pk-hex-drop-io.description:
Hex Drop.io is a 3D party battle in the sky. Six floors of hexagon tiles hang above the sea, and every tile you step on shakes and drops away. Fall through a hole and you land on the floor below. Fall past the last floor and you're out. Outlast 11 rivals, or team up with two friends against three other teams!

Every round is different: the lower floors take random shapes like rings, flowers, crosses, swirls and floating islands. Surprise events shake things up mid-round: Fast Drop, Low Gravity, Speed Rush, Slippery floors, Power Rain and Quakes. Grab glowing power-ups for speed, super jumps, slow feather falls or a mega push that sends rivals flying. Find a jump pad to bounce back up a floor.

Features:

Solo: last one standing against 11 rivals
Teams: 4 teams of 3, the last team standing wins
Six falling floors with new shapes every round
Surprise events that change the rules mid-round
Power-ups: Speed, Super Jump, Feather, Mega Push
Jump pads that launch you back up
Level up to earn coins and unlock new heroes, trails and themes
Shop with heroes, trails and sky themes
Progress saves to the cloud
Made for all devices, in landscape
pk-hex-drop-io.controls:
Mobile: drag anywhere on the screen to move, tap the pink button to jump.
Desktop: WASD or arrow keys to move, Space to jump, Esc for the menu.

pk-stick-blades-io.title: Stick Blades.io
pk-stick-blades-io.description:
Stick Blades.io is a 3D arena battle where every stickman carries a ring of swords spinning around them. Break crates and grab the swords lying around to make your ring bigger, then slice through your rivals. When two swords meet they both break, so pick your fights wisely! Tap ATTACK to spin your blades fast and wide for a moment, and hide in the bushes to ambush enemies or escape.

Three ways to play:

Classic: endless arena battle, climb the leaderboard
Zone: the arena shrinks, stay inside the zone and be the last one standing
Teams: 3 teams of 4, first team to 15 kills (or the most after 2:30) wins

Unlock special powers in the shop: Magnet, Shield, Vampire, Dash, Heal and Blade Storm.
pk-stick-blades-io.controls:
Mobile (landscape): left thumb on the joystick to move, right thumb on the red button to ATTACK and the blue button for your power. The pause button is top left.
Desktop: WASD or arrow keys to move, Space or J to ATTACK, E or K for your power, Esc to pause.

pk-wingworm-merge-cubes.title: Wingworm: Merge Cubes
pk-wingworm-merge-cubes.description:
Wingworm is a 3D snake arena where every piece of your tail is a number cube. Eat cubes to grow. When two cubes with the same number line up, they merge into a bigger one: 2+2 becomes 4, 4+4 becomes 8, all the way up to 2048 and beyond.

You're not alone. Rival winged snakes roam the arena, hunting cubes and coming after your tail. Hit a snake whose head is smaller than your cubes and you cut off part of its tail. Run your head into a bigger snake and you lose part of yours, or the whole run. Grow your head number, cut down the rivals and climb to the top of the live leaderboard.

Features:

Merge number cubes into ever bigger values
Rival snakes that grow with you and hunt your tail
Boost to escape danger or chase a target
Live leaderboard
Unlock cube styles, trails and arena skies in the shop
Earn coins every run, double them or continue after a crash
Progress saves to the cloud
Plays great on phones, in portrait or landscape
pk-wingworm-merge-cubes.controls:
Mobile: drag your finger to steer, tap the blue button to boost.
Desktop: move the mouse to steer, hold the left mouse button or Space to boost.

pk-sworded-spin-and-slash.title: Sworded: Spin & Slash
pk-sworded-spin-and-slash.description:
Sworded is a fast, colorful sword-fighting arena game where momentum is everything. Your blob drags a sword on a short arm – move in circles to swing it, or hold SPIN to whirl it around like a tornado. The faster your blade moves when it hits, the more damage it deals!

Clear each wave of rival blobs, collect orange XP orbs to level up and grow your sword, then pick one of three upgrades: sharper blades, longer swords, faster feet, more health, regeneration, lifesteal, armor or stronger spins. Every wave is bigger, tougher and takes place in a new arena – Crystal Plains, Scorched Desert, Frozen Field, Rainy Meadow, Misty Peaks and a lightning-filled Thunder Storm.

Features:
• Physics-based spin & swing sword combat – timing and positioning beat button mashing
• Blade clashes: swords that meet clang and bounce back
• Endless wave survival with roguelike upgrades after every wave
• 6 arenas with live weather: dust storms, snow, rain and thunder
• Level up during the fight – bigger blob, longer blade, more health
• Unlock 8 blob skins and 9 swords, including Crystal, Flame, Shadow and Golden blades
• Smooth 3D graphics, plays great on phone, tablet and desktop
• Free to play in your browser, no download needed
pk-sworded-spin-and-slash.controls:
Desktop:
• Mouse – move toward the cursor
• Left Click / Space (hold) – Spin
• WASD / Arrow Keys – move
• Esc – back to menu
• 1 / 2 / 3 – pick an upgrade

Mobile:
• Drag anywhere – move (virtual joystick)
• SPIN button (hold) – Spin
• Tap a card – pick an upgrade

pk-rocket-dash.title: Rocket Dash
pk-rocket-dash.description:
Rocket Dash is a one-tap space flyer about timing and nerve. Every tap fires your rocket's engine and lifts it up, while gravity keeps pulling it back down. Thread the gaps between towering asteroid columns, and don't touch the rocks or drop off the bottom of the screen.

Each gate you clear is a point. The further you fly, the faster your rocket goes and the narrower the gaps get, and after a few gates some of them start drifting up and down. Fly past ringed planets and distant moons across a deep, glowing starfield.

Every gate earns coins to spend in the shop on new rocket finishes like Comet, Crystal, Chrome, Neon and Galaxy, on sparkling engine trails, and on new skies from Nebula to Galaxy Core. Your best score, coins and unlocked items are saved, so you can pick up right where you left off.
pk-rocket-dash.controls: Mouse click / tap: fire engine. Keyboard: Space, Enter or Up Arrow to fire engine. Esc: pause.

pk-blade-spin.title: Blade Spin
pk-blade-spin.description: Blade Spin is a one-tap skill game. Tap to throw a knife into a spinning log, but be careful: if your knife hits one that is already stuck in the log, it's over. The log speeds up, slows down and even reverses as you progress, so timing is everything. Land every knife to clear the stage and collect apples along the way for bonus coins. Every fifth stage you face an angry boss log that spins faster with more knives to dodge, and beating it unlocks an exclusive knife. Travel through five worlds — Forest, Desert, Frozen Lake, Volcano and Night — spend your coins in the shop on 12 knives and upgrades like Juicy Apples, Coin Bonus and Spare Knife, and see how far you can go.
pk-blade-spin.controls:
Desktop: click the mouse or press Space to throw a knife, Esc or P to pause.
Mobile: tap anywhere on the screen to throw a knife.

pk-lane-hopper.title: Lane Hopper
pk-lane-hopper.description:
Lane Hopper is a colorful voxel arcade game where every hop counts. Guide your little hero across an endless world of busy roads, rushing rivers and rail tracks, one lane at a time.

Dodge cars and trucks speeding down the roads, jump onto floating logs and lily pads to cross the rivers without falling in, and watch for the flashing warning light before a train comes roaring through. Trees and rocks block your way on the grassy lanes, so plan your path carefully. Don't wait too long, though: the world keeps moving forward, and if you fall behind, the run is over.

The further you go, the faster the traffic gets and the longer the roads and rivers become. Pick up gold coins along the way and use them to unlock new heroes like Duckling, Penguin, Robot, Fox and Alien, plus hop trails and new worlds from Autumn and Candy to a snowy Winter. Your best score, coins and unlocked items are saved, so you can pick up right where you left off.
pk-lane-hopper.controls: Tap: hop forward. Swipe up, down, left or right: hop in that direction. Keyboard: Arrow keys or WASD to hop, Space to hop forward. Esc: pause.

pk-arrow-escape-2.title: Arrow Escape
pk-arrow-escape-2.description: Arrow Escape is a calm, clever puzzle game about order and planning. Every board is packed with colorful arrow tiles, and each arrow can only slide out in the direction it points. Tap an arrow to send it flying off the board — but if another arrow stands in its way, it's blocked and counts as a mistake. Find the right sequence to clear every tile and finish with no mistakes for three stars. With 200 handcrafted-feeling levels that grow from small 4×4 boards to big 9×9 puzzles, there's always a new challenge waiting. Stuck? Use a hint to light up an arrow that can escape right now, or skip the level. Earn coins as you play and unlock eight colorful themes in the shop, from Ocean and Sunset to Neon and Royal Gold.
pk-arrow-escape-2.controls:
Desktop: click an arrow to slide it out, press H for a hint, R to restart the level.
Mobile: tap an arrow to slide it out.

pk-helix-jump.title: Helix Jump
pk-helix-jump.description:
Helix Jump is a fast and satisfying one-finger 3D game.

A ball keeps bouncing on a tall spiral tower. Drag left and right to spin the tower so the ball falls through the gaps in each platform. Every floor you pass breaks apart and flies away. Land on a red part and it is game over, so watch where you spin!

Drop through three floors in a row without bouncing and your ball catches fire: the next platform it hits is smashed to pieces, even the red ones. Reach the golden ring at the bottom of the tower to clear the level.

Features:

One-finger controls that anyone can learn in seconds
Hundreds of levels that get taller and trickier as you go
Fire mode, shattering floors and paint splats where your ball bounces
A progress bar shows how close you are to the bottom
Shop with ball skins (Mint, Glossy, Beach, Neon, Lava, Gold, Rainbow), ball trails and backgrounds
Earn coins every level; watch an optional ad to continue after a fall, to double your coins, to try an item or for bonus coins
Your level, coins and items are saved to your PlayKovo account
Works on phones and desktop, no install needed
pk-helix-jump.controls:
Mobile: drag left and right to spin the tower.
Desktop: drag with the mouse, or use the arrow keys or A/D to spin the tower. Esc for the menu.

Since Helix now has music and sound effects, you could add a line like "Upbeat music and satisfying sound effects" to the features list.

pk-stack-tower.title: Stack Tower
pk-stack-tower.description:
Stack Tower is a simple and satisfying one-tap game.

A block slides back and forth above your tower. Tap to drop it. If it lands a little off, the part that hangs over the edge is sliced off and falls away, and your next block will be that much smaller. Land it perfectly and you keep the full size; hit three perfect drops in a row and the block even grows back a little.

The higher you build, the faster the blocks move. Miss the tower completely and the game is over. How tall can you go?

Features:

One-tap controls: easy for everyone, hard to master
Smooth 3D blocks in shifting colors, with sliced pieces tumbling away
Perfect drops, combos and a block that grows back when you are on a streak
Beat your best tower and keep improving
Shop with block themes (Pastel, Wood, Candy, Ice, Neon, Lava, Gold, Rainbow), perfect-drop effects and backgrounds (Night, Sunset, Snowfall, Candy, Space)
Earn coins every game; watch an optional ad to keep building after a miss, to double your coins, to try an item or for bonus coins
Your best score, coins and items are saved to your PlayKovo account
Works on phones and desktop, no install needed
pk-stack-tower.controls:
Mobile: tap anywhere to drop the block.
Desktop: click or press Space to drop the block, Esc for the menu.

pk-lance-arena.title: Lance Arena
pk-lance-arena.description: Lance Arena is a fast-paced arena brawler where your weapon grows with every orb you eat. Collect orbs to lengthen your lance, then hunt down rivals and knock them out with a precise poke to grab everything they drop. Strike from behind for double points, dash to close the gap or escape a bad joust, and watch out when two lance tips cross — they clash and bounce apart. Every run earns coins: spend them in the shop on 12 skins from Common to Legendary, or upgrade your starting lance, dash recharge, orb magnet and coin bonus. Got knocked out too early? Revive and jump straight back in with your lance intact. Climb the leaderboard, survive as long as you can and become #1 in the arena.
pk-lance-arena.controls:
Desktop: move the mouse to steer (or WASD / arrow keys), click or press Space to dash, Esc or P to pause.
Mobile: drag anywhere on the screen to steer with the virtual joystick, tap the DASH button (or tap with a second finger) to dash.

pk-crowd-clash-3d.title: Crowd Clash 3D
pk-crowd-clash-3d.description: Crowd Clash 3D is a crowd-building battle through busy city streets. Run through the city and every person your crowd touches joins your team in your color. The bigger your crowd gets, the more powerful it becomes: crowds that are smaller than yours get swallowed member by member, and once a rival leader runs out of followers, they join you too. But watch out — bigger crowds are hunting you, and rival crowd arrows at the edge of the screen show who is close. Each round lasts two minutes, and the biggest crowd when time runs out wins. Beat levels to progress through five cities — Sunny Town, Beach City, Snow Town, Neon Night and Desert — face giant boss crowds every fifth level, and earn up to three stars per level for finishing first, reaching the target crowd and swallowing rivals. Spend your coins on team colors, legendary leader skins with hats and upgrades for your starting crowd, recruit range, speed and coin bonus.
pk-crowd-clash-3d.controls:
Desktop: move the mouse in the direction you want your crowd to run (or use WASD / arrow keys), Esc or P to pause.
Mobile: drag anywhere on the screen to steer your crowd with the virtual joystick.

pk-archer-arena.title: Archer Arena
pk-archer-arena.description:
Archer Arena is a fast, easy-to-learn stickman archery battle game. Step into the arena, aim your bow and outlast, outshoot and outsmart a crowd of rival archers.

Four game modes keep every match fresh:
- Survival: 12 archers enter, one leaves. The safe zone keeps shrinking, so stay inside and stay alive.
- Team Battle: 6 vs 6 with bot teammates. Players respawn, and the first team to 15 eliminations wins.
- Boss Hunt: A giant boss fires arrow volleys at everyone. Dodge, shoot and deal the most damage to win.
- Gold Rush: Collect gold for 90 seconds. Arrows do not hurt here, they stun and make rivals drop their coins. The richest archer wins.

Play on six hand-painted maps: a misty bamboo forest, a snowy mountain with slippery ground, a sakura valley, a desert, a lake shore with ponds and a narrow canyon. Each one changes how you move and where you can hide.

Missed arrows stick in the ground, so you can pick them up and reuse them, and ammo crates appear around the map. Power-ups also drop on the field: Shield, Speed Boots, Triple Arrow, Explosive Arrow, Invisibility and Healing. One lucky pickup can turn the whole match around.

Win matches to earn coins and XP. Level up to unlock new modes and maps, complete quests and collect achievement badges. Spend coins in the shop on helmets, armor, special bows (ice, twin, golden), arrow trails, death effects and hero poses.

Features:
- 4 modes: Survival, Team Battle, Boss Hunt, Gold Rush
- 6 maps with unique obstacles
- 6 power-ups
- Quests, levels, achievements and a full shop
- Simple controls for mobile and desktop
- 8 languages: English, Turkish, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese and Russian

Matches last only two to three minutes, so you can jump in for a quick round or chase another win.
pk-archer-arena.controls:
Desktop: Move with W A S D or the arrow keys. Aim with the mouse. Press and hold the left mouse button to draw the bow and release to shoot (a longer pull shoots farther and faster). Press Esc to open the menu.
Mobile: Use the left joystick to move. Use the right joystick to aim and release to shoot. Tap the right joystick without dragging to auto-aim at the nearest enemy.

pk-splat-io.title: Splat.io
pk-splat-io.description:
Splat.io is a relaxed, colorful paint game for everyone.

You are a little paint blob on a giant blank canvas. Wherever you roll, you leave a trail of your color. Seven rivals are doing the same, and when someone paints over your color it becomes theirs. When the 90-second timer runs out, whoever owns the most paint wins the round.

Nobody gets knocked out and nobody can hurt you. If a rival paints over your work, just roll back and take it back.

Grab the power-ups that pop up on the canvas:
- Big Brush: a much wider trail for a few seconds
- Speed: zoom across the canvas
- Splat Bomb: instantly paints a huge splash

Features:
- Super easy to learn: just steer and paint
- Short 90-second rounds, perfect for a quick play
- A live paint share board and a mini map of the whole painting
- Always a full canvas: friendly bots join every round, so there is always a game to play
- Earn coins after every round, even when you finish last, and spend them in the Paint Shop on hats and blob skins like Rainbow, Sparkle, Galaxy and Gold
- Watch an optional ad to double your coins or to get bonus coins
- Your coins, hats, and skins are saved to your PlayKovo account
- Works on phones in landscape and on desktop, no install needed
pk-splat-io.controls:
Desktop: move the mouse to steer (the farther the cursor, the faster you go), WASD or arrow keys also steer, Esc pauses the game and opens the menu.
Mobile: drag the on-screen stick to steer. Play in landscape.

pk-wriggle-io.title: Wriggle.io
pk-wriggle-io.description:
Wriggle.io is a colorful, fast .io game about growing the longest gummy worm on the table.

Slide across a gingham picnic cloth covered in sprinkles. Every sprinkle you eat makes you longer. The longer you get, the more of the table your body covers, and the easier it is to trap the others: if a worm touches your body with its head, it is squished and drops all its sprinkles for you to grab.

But the same rule applies to you. Never let your head touch another worm's body or the edge of the table.

Features:
- Simple one-finger or one-mouse control, easy to learn and hard to put down
- Boost to sprint past rivals or cut them off, at the cost of some of your length
- A live leaderboard of the longest worms, with your rank on screen
- Always a full table: friendly bots fill the arena so a round is never empty
- Earn coins from every run and spend them in the Candy Shop on hats and worm skins
- Watch an optional ad to wriggle back after being squished, to double your coins, or to get bonus coins
- Your coins, hats, and skins are saved to your PlayKovo account
- Works on phones in landscape and on desktop, no install needed
pk-wriggle-io.controls:
Desktop: move the mouse to steer, hold the left mouse button (or Space) to boost, Esc opens the menu without pausing the game.
Mobile: drag the on-screen stick to steer, hold the BOOST button to sprint. Play in landscape.

pk-gulp-io.title: Gulp.io
pk-gulp-io.description:
Gulp.io is a free, fast-paced .io arena game where you play as a black hole with one goal: swallow everything. You start small in a busy city full of cones, bins, crates, trees and cars. Slide over anything smaller than your hole and it drops in, making you bigger.

The bigger you get, the bigger the things you can swallow. Go from picking up traffic cones to gulping buses, houses, apartment blocks, towers and even giant skyscrapers. A handy hint on screen always tells you what you can swallow next, so you know exactly how much to grow.

But you are not alone in the arena. Other holes are hunting for the same city, and the rule is simple: a hole that is clearly bigger than another can swallow it whole and steal most of its size. Chase smaller holes to grow fast, and run from the giants before they gulp you down. Use buildings and open space smartly, pick the right moment to attack and see how long you can survive.

There are no rounds and no waiting. Jump in, grow, get swallowed, and jump right back in for another run. Climb the live leaderboard, beat your own record and become the biggest hole in the city.

Play on desktop with the mouse or keyboard, or on your phone in landscape mode with a simple touch joystick. No sign-up needed, just pick a nickname and start swallowing.
pk-gulp-io.controls:
PC: Mouse - move your hole toward the cursor | WASD or arrow keys - alternative movement | Esc - open menu (the game keeps running).
Mobile (landscape): Touch and drag the joystick on the left side of the screen to move | Menu button (bottom-left) - open menu.

pk-punch-io-boxing-arena.title: Punch.io - Boxing Arena
pk-punch-io-boxing-arena.description:
Punch.io is a fast, free .io arena game where the only way to win is with your fists. You start as a tiny fighter with a pair of red boxing gloves in a huge arena packed with other players. Eat the glowing orbs scattered around the map to grow bigger, stronger and tougher, then use your size to dominate everyone around you.

Every punch counts. Land hits on rivals to send them flying and knock orbs out of their bodies, then snatch the orbs for yourself. Knock a fighter out completely and you steal a share of their mass, while the rest of it explodes into orbs for everyone to grab. Time a dash to lunge across the gap and land a powerful critical punch, but remember that big fighters hit hard and move slower, so staying smart matters as much as staying big.

Each round is quick to jump into and easy to learn: move, eat, punch, survive. Retreat to heal by collecting orbs, avoid fighters bigger than you, and gang up on the weak when the moment is right. Climb the live leaderboard, chase your best score and see how long you can stay the champion of the arena.

Play on desktop with mouse and keyboard, or on your phone in landscape with a simple touch joystick, a one-tap punch button with auto-aim and a dash button. No sign-up, no waiting, just pick a nickname and start punching.
pk-punch-io-boxing-arena.controls:
PC: Mouse - move and aim | Left click or Space - punch | Right click or Shift - dash | WASD or arrow keys - alternative movement | Esc - open menu (game keeps running).
Mobile (landscape): Drag anywhere on the screen - move | Red glove button - punch (auto-aims at the nearest rival) | DASH button - lunge forward | Menu button (top-left) - open menu.

pk-stickman-dash.title: Stickman Dash
