pk-stickman-dash.description:
Stickman Dash is a fast, satisfying action game where you are a lone stickman ninja with a single move: the dash. Pull back, aim, release, and slice straight through your enemies in one fluid motion.

Travel through eight levels set in beautiful misty landscapes: a bamboo forest, floating mountain peaks, a sakura valley and a ruined desert. Every level has its own look, its own music and its own challenges. Some enemies simply patrol, some shoot arrows from a distance, and some carry shields that bounce you back. After each stage a boss waits for you, and each boss fights differently, so learn their patterns before you strike.

Earn stars on every level by taking as little damage as possible, and chain kills quickly to build a combo that boosts both your score and your coin rewards. Think you can do better? Try Endless Mode, where waves of enemies get tougher and tougher, and see how far you can go before you fall.

Spend your coins in the shop to build your own stickman. Pick a helmet such as a samurai kabuto, a knight helm, a viking horned helmet or a golden crown. Wear armor to gain extra hearts. Equip swords like the golden, shadow, ice and laser blades that earn you more coins from every enemy you defeat.

Features:
- Simple one-touch drag and release controls, easy to learn and hard to master
- 8 levels with 4 boss fights
- Endless Mode with growing difficulty
- Star ratings and combo scoring
- Shop with helmets, armor and swords
- Hand-painted style backgrounds and calm Japanese-inspired music
- Available in 8 languages: English, Turkish, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese and Russian
- Works on desktop and mobile in portrait mode

Short sessions, instant restarts and a smooth difficulty curve make Stickman Dash perfect for a quick break or a longer run for the high score.
pk-stickman-dash.controls:
Mobile: Touch and hold to slow down time, drag in the opposite direction of where you want to go, then release to dash.
Desktop: Press and hold the left mouse button, drag back to aim, then release to dash through enemies.
Tip: Slice through enemies to defeat them, avoid arrows, and watch out for shielded enemies and bosses that flash red.

pk-lumira-word-puzzle-game.title: Lumira: Word Puzzle Game
pk-lumira-word-puzzle-game.description:
Lumira is a relaxing crossword-style word puzzle game. Connect letters on the wheel to spell words, and every correct word drops into the crossword grid. Fill the whole grid to clear the level and move on to the next one.

GAMEPLAY
Each level gives you a handful of letters and an empty crossword grid. Drag across the letters to form words of different lengths. Valid words snap into place; extra valid words that aren't on the grid count as bonus words and earn coins. Stuck? Shuffle the letters to see them in a new way, or spend coins on a hint to reveal a letter.

GOALS
Work your way through 750 hand-crafted levels. They start easy and gradually introduce longer words and bigger grids. Along the way you travel through 15 illustrated regions, from twilight gardens and starlit deserts to tropical coasts, Everest's summit, the Amazon rainforest and enchanted valleys. Every region has its own scenery.

SESSION STYLE
Levels take just a few minutes, so Lumira fits a coffee break, a commute or winding down before bed. Your progress is saved, so you can pick up right where you left off. A new Daily Puzzle every day, daily quests and a free daily wheel spin give you a reason to come back.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
• Co-op: invite a friend with a room code and solve the same puzzle together in real time
• Duel: face an opponent in a fast 1v1 word race. Whoever solves it first wins.

WHY PLAY LUMIRA?
• 750 levels and 15 illustrated regions
• Play in 29 languages, from English, Spanish and German to Japanese, Korean, Arabic and Hindi
• Calming music and soft sound effects
• Easy to learn, with no account needed to start
• A fun way to keep your mind sharp and grow your vocabulary

If you love crosswords, anagrams or word searches, Lumira turns a few spare minutes into a calm, satisfying word ritual.
pk-lumira-word-puzzle-game.controls: Mouse: click and drag across letters, release to submit. Touch: swipe across letters, lift your finger to submit. Tap buttons for Hint, Shuffle and menus.

pk-hexanaut-io.title: Hexanaut.io
pk-hexanaut-io.description: Description: Hexanaut.io is a free browser .io game where you capture hexagonal territory by looping your tail around tiles, similar to Splix.io or Paper.io but rendered in 3D. Grab totems for passive bonuses, team up in Duo mode, or fight solo in a server of up to 45 players. Reach 20% map ownership to become King and hold the lead for 3 minutes to win.
pk-hexanaut-io.controls: Controls: Mouse — aim your direction. W/A/S/D or Arrow Keys — steer with keyboard. Click or Space — activate a PRO item. Mobile — on-screen joystick to steer, tap button to use item.

pk-lolshot-io.title: LOLShot.io
pk-lolshot-io.description: LOLShot.io is a free multiplayer .io FPS game online - no download needed. Share an invite link to play with friends in this competitive skill-based first person shooter packed with aerial action. Score points for spectacular combos: yeet other players out of the arena, perform mid-air kills and teleport through portals to ambush opponents.
pk-lolshot-io.controls:
Movement: W, A, S, D
Shoot: LMB
Jump: Space or RMB
Switch weapons: Mouse wheel or 1,2,3...8
Chat: Return
Settings: ESC
Reload by picking up weapons

pk-toy-box-challenge.title: Toy Box Challenge
pk-toy-box-challenge.description:
Build your way up using a box full of colorful toys.

Grab pieces from different points to rotate them, balance your structure, and get Astro completely above the target line. Keep everything stable long enough for Astro to plant the flag!

Each level gives you a new height to reach and a different set of pieces to work with.

Complete all 8 levels and try to beat your best times.
pk-toy-box-challenge.controls: Mouse — click and drag toys to move them. Grab different parts of a toy to change its orientation. Release to drop.

pk-warbirds-io.title: Warbirds.io
pk-warbirds-io.description: Warbirds.io is a free browser multiplayer dogfighter set in a Minecraft-inspired voxel world. Pick a side and fight for control of a single golden ring, taking to the skies in planes, rolling out in tanks, or commanding warships across the map. Every vehicle class has its own controls and weapons, from aerial dogfights and bombing runs to tank duels and naval gunnery. No download required — play instantly in your browser, alone or with friends.
pk-warbirds-io.controls:
AIRCRAFT
W/↑ Pitch up · S/↓ Pitch down · A/← Roll left · D/→ Roll right
Q Rudder left · E Rudder right
Shift (or Z) Throttle up · Ctrl (or X) Throttle down

WARSHIPS
W/S Engine telegraph (reverse at bottom) · A/D Rudder
Mouse Train guns (auto-ranged) · Click/Space Fire
B Torpedoes · C Smoke · Z Zoom · X Swap shells · R Damage control · T Repair party · G Boost · F Leave ship

GENERAL
Tab (hold) Scoreboard · Enter Chat · H (hold) Comms wheel · M Mute · O Settings

MOBILE
Left thumbstick Steer · Left slider Throttle · FIRE button Shoot · Right drag Look around · On-screen chips Crew actions

pk-spin-maze.title: Spin Maze
pk-spin-maze.description:
Spin Maze is a relaxing ball-and-maze puzzle that is easy to start and hard to put down.

Drag to spin the maze and let gravity roll the ball toward the exit. Think ahead, turn at the right moment, and slip the ball out through the gap. Every level has 3 mazes to escape, and every maze is new.

FEATURES
• Square, round and triangle mazes with a fresh layout every time
• Endless levels that slowly get bigger and trickier
• Smooth, satisfying ball physics
• Collect coins and unlock 8 sports balls: soccer, basketball, tennis, volleyball, beach ball, baseball, 8-ball and golf ball
• Stuck on a level? Skip it with a quick video
• Bright, colorful visuals and calm music
• One-finger controls, play anywhere, anytime

Can you roll your way out of every maze?
pk-spin-maze.controls:
• Mobile: touch the screen and drag in a circle around the maze to spin it.
• Desktop: drag with the mouse, or use the Left / Right arrow keys (or A / D).

TIPS
• The ball always rolls "down", so spin the maze to change which way it rolls.
• The white arrow shows where the exit is.
• Spin slowly near tight turns.
• Stuck? Tap SKIP to move on to the next level.

pk-morph-dash.title: Morph Dash
pk-morph-dash.description:
Morph Dash is a fast, colorful endless runner with one simple twist: your shape keeps changing!

Roll down a winding, hilly road in three lanes. Every wall has holes in different shapes: circle, square and triangle. Slide into the lane whose hole fits your current shape and slip through. Pick the wrong one and you crash.

But walls are only the start. Watch out for red spikes, pits in the road, solid blocks and zig-zag slalom sections that test your reflexes. The longer you survive, the faster it gets and the more tricky patterns you’ll see.

Features:

Easy one-thumb controls, perfect for quick sessions
Winding roads and rolling hills that change as you play
Walls, spikes, pits and slalom sections that keep every run different
Collect gems and earn coins after every run
Unlock skins in the shop, including a color-shifting Rainbow skin
Watch a video to continue after a crash or multiply your coins
Bright, cheerful visuals and an upbeat soundtrack

How far can you go? Beat your best score and morph your way to the top!
pk-morph-dash.controls:
Mobile: tap the left side of the screen to move left, tap the right side to move right
Desktop: Left / Right arrow keys or A / D keys
Desktop (mouse): click the left or right half of the screen
Pause button: top-left corner

pk-drift-road.title: Drift Road
pk-drift-road.description:
Drift Road is a fast, addictive one-touch driving game. Grab the steering wheel, slide through sharp curves and keep your car on the road as long as you can. The road keeps twisting, the speed keeps rising and every run gets harder.
Collect gems along the way, climb up your best score and spend your coins in the Garage to unlock new cars like the Taxi, Ghost, Candy and the Police car with its wailing siren. Crash? Watch a short video to revive and keep your streak alive, or claim bonus coins with the multiplier meter.
Easy to learn, hard to master. Perfect for quick breaks and for chasing a new high score.
FEATURES
- Simple one-finger steering wheel controls
- Endless winding roads with changing colour themes
- 10 unlockable cars, each with its own engine sound
- Collect gems and earn coins every run
- Revive after a crash and win bonus coin multipliers
- Skid marks, drift effects and satisfying crash feedback
- Saves your progress and best score
pk-drift-road.controls:
Mobile: Touch and drag the steering wheel at the bottom of the screen left or right.
Desktop: Drag the wheel with the mouse, or use the Left / Right arrow keys (A / D). Press Space or Enter to start.

pk-sky-roll.title: Sky Roll
pk-sky-roll.description:
Sky Roll is a fast, colorful 3D rolling-ball arcade game. Steer your ball along floating ramps high above the clouds, jump over gaps, avoid holes and obstacles, and hit boost pads to fly through the air. The longer you survive, the faster it gets!

Collect gems on every run and spend them in the shop to unlock new balls: Snow, Ruby, Basketball, Beach Ball, Tennis, Gold, 8 Ball, Leopard, Disco, Planet and Lava. Watch a video to unlock balls for free, or revive after a crash to keep your run going.

Upgrade your income, beat your best score and see how far you can roll. Easy to learn, hard to put down. Play Sky Roll free on PlayKovo.
pk-sky-roll.controls:
Mobile: touch and drag left or right to steer.
Desktop: move the mouse while dragging, or use Left/Right Arrow keys or A / D.

pk-hexa-spin.title: Hexa Spin
pk-hexa-spin.description: Hexa Spin is a fast, colorful puzzle-arcade game. Colored blocks fall toward a glowing hexagon from six directions. Spin the hexagon to choose which side catches each block, stack matching colors and watch them pop. Link clears into chain reactions and keep your combo timer alive for huge scores. The longer you play, the faster and trickier the patterns get, and new color themes unlock as your score climbs. If a side stacks too high, it’s game over, but you can watch a short video to continue your run. One-touch controls make it perfect for quick breaks on mobile or desktop.
pk-hexa-spin.controls:
Mobile: tap the left half of the screen to spin left, the right half to spin right
Desktop: Left/Right arrow keys or A/D to spin, Space to start
Mouse: click the left or right half of the screen

pk-dune-glide.title: Dune Glide
pk-dune-glide.description:
Dune Glide is a relaxing yet addictive one-tap arcade game. Slide your ball down endless golden dunes, build up speed and launch off the peaks to soar through the sky!

Time your dives perfectly: hold to press down into the valleys and pick up speed, then release at the top of a hill to fly. Land in line with the slope for a SMOOTH landing and build a huge combo. Land badly and your combo is gone, or you crash!

Fly high above the sky line and all the way to the moon for bonus points. Collect coins along the sand and in the air, then spend them in the shop on new ball skins with their own glowing trails. Watch the world shift through beautiful themes as your score climbs.

Features:
- Simple one-tap controls, easy to learn and hard to master
- Smooth, satisfying physics with combo landings
- Coins to collect on the sand and high in the sky
- 8 unlockable ball skins with glowing trails
- Gorgeous changing themes with planets, stars and moons
- Relaxing music and wind sound effects
- Play quick rounds or chase your best score

How far can you glide?
pk-dune-glide.controls:
Mouse / Touch: Press and hold to dive, release to fly
Keyboard: Hold Space or Down Arrow to dive, release to fly

pk-ring-dash.title: Ring Dash
pk-ring-dash.description:
Ring Dash is a one-tap arcade game. You start on a circle and tap to dash in a straight line to the next one. Between the two circles, colored rings spin around the target. The colored arcs are deadly, the grey parts are safe. Dash through a gap and you land, miss the timing and the run is over.

The farther you climb, the harder it gets. Single rings turn into two rings spinning in opposite directions, arcs split into several pieces, some rings reverse direction, and saw blades start sliding across the path. Dashing through the middle of a gap counts as a perfect dash and adds bonus points that grow with your combo.

Collect gems along the path to unlock new ball skins. The background theme changes every 10 points, and your best score is saved so you can try to beat it. If a run ends, you can watch a short video to continue from where you fell.
pk-ring-dash.controls: Mouse click, screen tap, Space or Up Arrow: dash

pk-don-t-fall.title: Don't Fall
pk-don-t-fall.description:
Don't Fall is a fast, one-tap arcade game. A ball rolls along a narrow isometric path that twists left and right, and your only job is to turn at the right moment and stay on the track. Miss a corner and the ball drops off the edge.

Every corner you clear adds a point, and turning close to the centre of the tile earns a PERFECT bonus that builds into a streak. Gems are scattered along the path, and some tiles start to crumble the moment you step on them, so keep moving. The world changes colour as your score climbs, with a new theme every 20 points.

Spend the coins you earn in the shop to unlock new balls and trail effects, from classic and gold to planet, disco and lava balls, and from stars and hearts to rainbow and fire trails. If you fall late in a run you can revive and carry on from the last tile you were standing on.
pk-don-t-fall.controls: Tap or click anywhere on the screen to turn. On keyboard, press Space or the Up arrow.

pk-twist-hop.title: Twist Hop
pk-twist-hop.description:
Twist Hop is a fast, satisfying one-tap arcade game. Your ball hops from block to block along a banked, curving, endless path that climbs higher and higher. Spot a gap ahead? Tap at the right moment to leap over it!

Chain perfect jumps to build a streak and watch the NICE, GREAT and AWESOME combos pop. Grab pink gems along the way, turn them into coins and unlock 12 unique ball skins, from Classic and Gold to Disco, Planet and Lava. The world changes color as you go, so every run looks fresh.

Easy to learn, hard to put down. How far can you hop?

Features:
- Simple one-tap controls
- Endless twisting 3D path
- Streak combos and gems to collect
- 12 collectible ball skins
- Income upgrade to earn coins faster
- Color themes that change as you climb
- Save your progress and chase your best score
pk-twist-hop.controls:
Mobile: Tap the screen to jump over a gap.
Desktop: Click the mouse, or press Space / Arrow Up to jump.

pk-tunnel-spin.title: Tunnel Spin
pk-tunnel-spin.description:
Tunnel Spin is a 3D arcade game where your ball rolls nonstop along the floor of a long tunnel that bends left, right, up and down. You can't steer the ball. You rotate the whole tunnel around it instead.

Walls with notches cut into their rim block the way, and you have to turn the tunnel until a notch sits right over the ball. Further in, spike patches stick out of the walls, saw blades spin at the edges (some of them slide back and forth), and fan bars sweep across the whole tunnel. The ball speeds up with every obstacle you pass.

Roll through a notch dead center to score a PERFECT, and chain them for a streak. Grab the coin rows along the walls, then spend coins in the shop on 12 balls, including Basketball, Tennis, Leopard, Disco, Planet and Lava. You can also upgrade Income to earn more coins per run. The tunnel colors change as your score climbs.
pk-tunnel-spin.controls:
Mobile: Swipe left / right to rotate the tunnel
Desktop: Drag with the mouse, or use Arrow Left / Arrow Right (A / D)
Space / Enter: Start the game

pk-spike-bounce.title: Spike Bounce
pk-spike-bounce.description:
Spike Bounce is a one-tap arcade game about a small bird stuck between two spiky walls. The bird flies sideways on its own, and each tap makes it flap upward. Touch a wall and you score a point, the bird turns around, and new spikes slide out of the opposite wall.

The top and bottom of the screen are lined with spikes too, so you have to keep the bird in the air without flying too high. You start with two spikes per wall, then more appear and the bird speeds up as your score climbs. Every wall always has a gap wide enough to get through. Every 5 points the background changes color, across 8 color themes in total.

Candy shows up in the middle of the screen. Collect it for coins and spend them in the shop on 10 birds, including Chick, Froggy, Angel, Devil and King. Your best score and games played are saved, so you can come back and try to beat your record.
pk-spike-bounce.controls:
Mobile: Tap the screen to flap
Desktop: Click, Space or Up Arrow to flap

pk-pin-spin.title: Pin Spin
pk-pin-spin.description:
Pin Spin is a timing game about a spinning circle and a row of pins waiting to be shot. Tap to fire a pin so it sticks into the circle. If it hits a pin that is already there, the level is lost. Land every pin to clear the level and move on to the next one.

Levels start slow and simple, then add pins already stuck in the circle and faster spins. Later the circle speeds up and slows down, reverses direction or stops and starts again, so you have to watch the rhythm before each shot.

Earn coins as you play and spend them on pin styles, from plain colors to stars, hearts, gems and rainbow pins. After a level you can watch a short video to multiply your coins, or to continue after a miss.
pk-pin-spin.controls: Tap or click anywhere on the screen to shoot a pin. On a keyboard, press Space, Enter or the Up Arrow.

pk-stick-bridge.title: Stick Bridge
pk-stick-bridge.description:
Stick Bridge is a one-tap timing game. Your ninja stands on a pillar and the next pillar waits across a gap. Hold to grow a stick, then release it to drop the stick down as a bridge. If the stick is too short or too long, the ninja falls into the sea.

Each pillar in the middle has a small red spot. If the end of your stick lands on it, you get a Perfect, which is worth bonus points. Land Perfects in a row to build a combo, and every combo step adds more points. Coins float above some gaps. Cross the stick to collect them.

The scenery changes every 10 points: Meadow, Sunset, Candy, Night and Snow. Pillars get narrower and gaps get harder to judge as your score grows. Use your coins to unlock 9 ninja skins, including Froggy, Angel, Devil and King. Your best score and coins are saved.
pk-stick-bridge.controls:
Mouse: hold the left button to grow the stick, release to drop it.
Touch: hold your finger on the screen to grow the stick, lift to drop it.
Keyboard: hold Space or the Up Arrow to grow the stick, release to drop it.

pk-pet-merge.title: Pet Merge
pk-pet-merge.description:
Pet Merge is a cute physics merge puzzle. Aim and drop an animal into the glass box, then watch it tumble onto the pile. When two pets of the same kind touch, they merge into the next one in the chain: Chick, Mouse, Hamster, Bunny, Kitty, Puppy, Fox, Panda, Koala, Lion and finally the golden crowned cat. Merge several pairs in a row to build combos and score big, but keep an eye on the red line at the top. If the pile stays above it for too long, the box is full and the round is over.

Three boosters help when the box gets crowded. Sweep clears the tiny pets, the Hammer smashes any pet you tap, and Shake rattles the box so everything settles into new gaps. Choose Classic mode to play at your own pace or Time Rush to score as much as you can in two minutes. Earn coins from big merges, fill the gift bar for bonus rewards and unlock new box themes in the shop. Your best scores, coins and unlocks are saved automatically.
pk-pet-merge.controls: Mouse or touch: move to aim, click or release to drop the pet. Hammer booster: tap a pet to smash it. Sweep and Shake: tap the booster button.

pk-layers-roll.title: Layers Roll
pk-layers-roll.description:
Layers Roll is a fast, colorful one-finger 3D runner where your roll is your score.

You run on top of a giant rolling disc, wrapped in layers like a roll of carpet. Roll over the color strips on the road: a strip that matches your roll wraps new layers around it and makes it bigger, while a wrong color peels layers off. Color gates repaint your roll, and plus, times, minus and divide gates let you pick the better side. Chain perfect strips for a combo bonus and grab paint buckets for extra layers.

The road winds and dips through five worlds: Snowy Peaks, Sunny Beach, Sky Islands, Desert Canyon and Autumn Woods. As you progress, new hazards appear: rolling barrels, swinging wrecking balls, pop-up spikes, hydraulic crushers, spinning saws, sticky slime, ramps and broken bridges. Every third level ends with a boss wall that only a big enough roll can smash.

At the finish line your roll keeps going and slowly unwinds into a long carpet behind you. The more layers you still have, the further you roll into the x1 to x10 bonus zones and the more coins you win. Your roll also paints a colorful track on the road as you go.

Features:

One-finger controls that anyone can learn in seconds
Curvy 3D roads in five worlds with snow, falling leaves and floating islands
Dozens of hazards, boss walls and bonus gates that keep every level fresh
Perfect-run combos, paint buckets and ramps with coins in the air
Shop with outfits, skin tones, hair, beards, tattoos, gloves and roll patterns (Stripes, Candy, Stars, Gold, Rainbow, Galaxy)
Upgrade your starting layers and your income
Daily gifts and free VIP gifts for playing every day
Earn coins every level; watch an optional ad to continue after a fall, multiply your coins or get a free gift
Your level, coins and items are saved to your PlayKovo account
Works on phones and desktop, no install needed
pk-layers-roll.controls:
Mobile: touch and drag left or right to steer the roll.
Desktop: drag with the mouse, or use the arrow keys or A / D. Press Space or Enter to start the run.

pk-color-clash-paint-the-board.title: Color Clash – Paint the Board Cannon Battle Game
pk-color-clash-paint-the-board.description: Color Clash is a colorful cannon battle where every shot paints the board! Hold to fire, drag to aim, and turn the tiles to your color before the timer runs out. Each level brings something new: break through walls of blocks, multiply your bullets with x2 and x3 gates, bounce shots off bumpers, and fire into moving black holes to strike enemies hiding behind an unbreakable wall. Face one, two or even three rival cannons at once, and destroy their cannons to win instantly. Earn coins after every level and upgrade Multi Shot, Speed and Power to dominate tougher arenas. Short rounds, simple one-finger controls and satisfying painting action make Color Clash perfect for quick play on mobile and desktop.
pk-color-clash-paint-the-board.controls:
Mobile: Touch and hold to fire, drag to aim.
Desktop: Click and hold the left mouse button to fire, move the mouse to aim.

pk-burrow-worms.title: Burrow Worms
pk-burrow-worms.description: Burrow Worms is an underground worm battle in a world you dig yourself. Tunnel through the dirt, leave a trail of open caves behind you and gobble up green, yellow, blue and rare red gems to grow longer. Watch out for glowing lava pockets and solid rock, and never let your head touch another worm's body — you'll be knocked out and your length spills out as gems for everyone else. Turn the tables by boosting ahead of a rival to cut them off, and heal when the lava gets too close. Every run takes place in a different underground world — Dirt, Clay, Desert, Ice Cave, Volcano or Crystal Cave — and you can pick from four modes: endless Classic, the 3-minute Gem Rush where the longest worm wins, Lava Rising where the arena shrinks as lava creeps in, and Darkness where only your own light shows the way. Earn coins to unlock 12 worm skins and six upgrades: Lava Armor, Lean Boost, Big Start, Coin Bonus, Gem Magnet and Power Drill.
pk-burrow-worms.controls:
Desktop: move the mouse to steer (or WASD / arrow keys), hold Space or Left Click to boost, hold Shift or Right Click to heal, Esc or P to pause.
Mobile: use the joystick in the bottom-left corner to steer (touch anywhere on the left half of the screen), hold BOOST to speed up and HEAL to restore health. Play in landscape.

pk-party-dash-knockout-race.title: Party Dash: Knockout Race
pk-party-dash-knockout-race.description:
Party Dash is a chaotic knockout race for 20 players! Dodge swinging hammers, jump spinning sweepers, cross narrow beams, bounce off pads and survive falling tiles on one huge course split into 4 stages.

Each checkpoint lets in only a limited number of racers: 13, then 8, then 4. When a gate fills up, everyone behind it is out! Push to the front, clear all three checkpoints and be the first across the finish line to win the crown.

• 7 worlds: Candy Canyon, Hammer Hills, Spin City, Tile Tumble, Push Palace, Frosty Peaks and Chaos Castle
• The course is reshuffled every race, so no two runs are the same
• 12 obstacle types: hammers, sweepers, pushers, bumpers, conveyor belts, bounce pads and more
• Free 3D camera you can turn with the mouse or a finger
• Cute jelly-bean racers with skins and hats to unlock
• Smart bots, so you can play anytime, even offline
pk-party-dash-knockout-race.controls:
PC: WASD / Arrow keys to run · Space to jump · Mouse to turn the camera (click to lock the mouse) · Esc to pause
Mobile: Left side of the screen to move · Right side swipe to turn the camera · JUMP button to jump

pk-robo-sweep-io.title: Robo Sweep.io
pk-robo-sweep-io.description:
Robo Sweep.io is a 3D cleaning game where you drive a robot vacuum through a messy house. Every pass leaves a sparkling clean trail behind you. Crumbs, socks, cans, pizza slices, donuts, shoes, toy cars and even teddy bears all go up the nozzle!

Two ways to play:

Arena: an endless .io battle against 14 rival robots. Suck up dirt and trash to grow. Get close to a smaller robot and your suction drags it in. Stay away from the bigger ones! Use turbo to escape or catch up, and climb the live leaderboard.
Rooms: clean the Kids Room, Living Room, Bedroom, Bathroom, Small WC, Kitchen and Guest Room before time runs out. Steer around beds, sofas, tables and bathtubs, grab speed and 2x suction power-ups, and reach 85% to unlock the next room. Earn up to 3 stars in each room!

Features:

Two modes: Arena (.io) and Rooms (timed cleaning levels)
7 furnished rooms to unlock
20+ kinds of trash, from crumbs to teddy bears
Sparkling clean trails and dirt that slowly comes back
Turbo meter that refills on its own
Next-goal rewards and levels that unlock new robots, trails and floors
Shop with robots, trails and floor themes
Progress saves to the cloud
Made for phones, in portrait or landscape
pk-robo-sweep-io.controls:
Mobile: drag anywhere on the screen to drive, hold the yellow button for turbo.
Desktop: WASD or arrow keys to drive, Space or Shift for turbo, Esc for the menu.

pk-tank-evo-arena.title: Tank Evo Arena
pk-tank-evo-arena.description:
Tank Evo Arena is a fast, colorful top-down tank shooter. Start as a small tank, destroy squares, triangles and pentagons to earn XP, and grow stronger with every level.

Spend upgrade points on 8 stats: health regen, max health, body damage, bullet speed, penetration, bullet damage, reload and movement speed. At levels 15, 30 and 45, evolve into one of 19 tank classes: Twin, Sniper, Machine Gun, Overseer with drones, Destroyer, Penta Shot, Octo Tank, Overlord and more.

Choose your battle:

Free For All: 13 smart rivals, climb to the top of the leaderboard.
2 Teams: blue vs red, first team to 25 kills wins.
Boss Battle: team up and defeat 3 giant bosses.

Earn coins and customize your tank with colors, decals, barrel skins and bullet trails. Buy permanent perks such as XP Bonus, Coin Bonus, Head Start and Spawn Shield. Daily rewards, 8 languages and cloud save are included, and it plays on both mobile and desktop.
pk-tank-evo-arena.controls:
Desktop:

WASD / Arrow keys – Move
Mouse – Aim
Left click / Space – Shoot
E – Toggle auto fire
C – Toggle auto spin
1–8 – Upgrade stats
Esc – Pause

Mobile (landscape):

Left joystick – Move
Right joystick – Aim and shoot
Auto fire button – Shoot automatically
"+" button – Open upgrades

pk-water-sort-puzzle.title: Water Sort Puzzle
pk-water-sort-puzzle.description:
Water Sort Puzzle is a relaxing and satisfying color sorting game. Tap a tube to pick it up, then tap another to pour. The liquid can only go on top of the same color or into an empty tube, and each tube holds just four layers. Sort every color into its own tube to clear the level.

It starts easy with just a few colors, then new colors and extra challenge are added as you progress, up to twelve colors. Plan your moves carefully: the right pour at the right time makes all the difference. Every level is checked to make sure it can be solved, and if you get stuck you can undo a move, restart the level or add an extra empty tube.

Earn coins for every level you clear, open a bonus chest every five levels and unlock new looks in the shop: stylish tubes like Lab Tube, Neon, Gold Rim and Royal, fresh liquid color palettes, and cozy rooms from a Sunny Kitchen and Greenhouse to a Beach Bar, Space Lab and Candy Shop. Your level, coins and unlocked items are saved, so you can pick up right where you left off.
pk-water-sort-puzzle.controls: Mouse / touch: tap a tube to select it, tap another tube to pour. Keyboard: number keys 1-9 and 0 to pick tubes, Ctrl+Z to undo, R to restart, Esc for the menu.

pk-screw-pop.title: Screw Pop
pk-screw-pop.description: Screw Pop is a relaxing yet clever wood-and-bolts puzzle. Colorful wooden planks are stacked on a workbench and held in place by screws. Tap a screw that isn't covered by another plank to unscrew it — it flies straight into the crate of the same color. Each crate holds three screws, and when it's full a new color takes its place. Screws that don't match any open crate wait in a small row of slots, so plan ahead: if every slot fills up and no screw fits a crate, you're out of space. Take out a plank's screws and it swings from its last bolt before dropping off the board. With 200 levels that grow from a few simple planks to crowded, tricky workbenches, there's always a new puzzle to crack. Stuck? Use a hint to light up a safe screw, or add an extra waiting slot. Earn coins and stars as you play and unlock seven wood themes, from Walnut and Cherry to Bamboo and Gold Leaf.
pk-screw-pop.controls:
Desktop: click a screw to unscrew it, press H for a hint, R to restart the level.
Mobile: tap a screw to unscrew it.

pk-color-switch-3d.title: Color Switch 3D
pk-color-switch-3d.description:
Color Switch 3D is a one-tap arcade game of timing and color matching. Your ball can only pass through the parts of an obstacle that share its own color: cyan, purple, yellow or pink. Touch any other color and it bursts into pieces.

Climb past spinning four-color rings, rotating crosses and sliding color bars that get faster the higher you go. Rainbow switchers between obstacles repaint your ball in a new color, so you always have to read the next obstacle and adapt. Every star you collect adds to your score and earns coins.

Spend your coins in the shop on ball finishes, trails and dark backgrounds. Your best score, coins and unlocked items are saved, so you can pick up right where you left off. Easy to learn, hard to put down.
pk-color-switch-3d.controls: Mouse click / tap: jump. Keyboard: Space, Enter or Up Arrow to jump. Esc: pause.

pk-zigzag.title: Zigzag
pk-zigzag.description:
Zigzag is a fast, addictive one-tap game.

A ball rolls along a narrow zigzag path high above the clouds. Tap to switch its direction at every corner and keep it on the path. Miss a turn and the ball falls into the void.

The path crumbles away behind you and the ball keeps getting faster, so every run becomes a test of rhythm and focus. Grab the sparkling gems along the way to earn coins.

Features:

One-tap controls: easy to learn, hard to master
An endless, ever-changing path that gets faster and twistier
Sparkling gems to collect and a best score to beat
Satisfying sound effects for every turn, gem and milestone
Colors that change as you travel further
Shop with ball skins (Mint, Glossy, Beach, Neon, Lava, Gold, Rainbow), trails and backgrounds
Watch an optional ad to continue after a fall, to double your coins, to try an item or for bonus coins
Your best score, coins and items are saved to your PlayKovo account
Works on phones and desktop, no install needed
pk-zigzag.controls:
Mobile: tap anywhere to turn.
Desktop: click, or press Space or the Up arrow to turn. Esc for the menu.

pk-land-grab-3d.title: Land Grab 3D
pk-land-grab-3d.description: Land Grab 3D is a colorful territory battle on a 3D board. Your cube starts on a small patch of land. Step outside it to draw a trail behind you, then return home to claim everything you enclosed as your color — watch the new blocks pop up from the ground. The bigger the loop, the more land you win, but while you're outside your territory you are vulnerable: if a rival touches your trail, you're out. Turn the tables by cutting their trails, surround their land to steal it, and take over every block they own to knock them out of the game. Earn coins every run to unlock 14 cube skins and upgrade your starting base, speed and coin bonus. Grab as much of the map as you can and climb to the top of the leaderboard.
pk-land-grab-3d.controls:
Desktop: move the mouse to steer your cube (or use WASD / arrow keys), Esc or P to pause.
Mobile: drag anywhere on the screen to steer with the virtual joystick.

pk-glob-io.title: Glob.io
pk-glob-io.description:
Glob.io is a fast, colorful 3D take on the classic blob-eating .io game.

You start as a tiny glob in a bright arena full of glowing gems. Eat them to grow. Once you are clearly bigger than another glob, roll over it to swallow it whole. But watch your back: anyone bigger than you can do the same.

Split in two to lunge at prey, eject mass to feed teammates or bait rivals, and use the green spiky viruses wisely: they pop big globs into pieces, and if you feed one seven times it shoots a new virus straight at your enemy.

Two modes:

Free for all: grow as big as you can and climb the leaderboard.
Teams: Blue vs Red, first team to 15 eliminations or the higher score when the clock runs out. Grab power-ups like Invisibility, Speed, Shield and Magnet to turn the fight around.

Features:

Real 3D arena with smooth camera that zooms out as you grow
Smart bots that hunt, flee, split and even shoot viruses, so every match is full
Shop with skins (Galaxy, Lava, Gold, Rainbow and more), colored names, particle trails and arena themes
Earn coins every round; watch an optional ad for bonus coins, to double your reward, to try an item, or to come back into the fight
Coins and items are saved to your PlayKovo account
Works on phones and desktop, no install needed
pk-glob-io.controls:
Desktop: move the mouse to steer, Space to split, hold W to eject mass, mouse wheel to zoom, Esc for the menu.
Mobile: touch and drag to steer, tap SPLIT to split, hold W to eject mass. Play in landscape for the best view.

pk-hop-io.title: Hop.io
pk-hop-io.description:
Hop.io is a relaxed, colorful frog game for everyone.

You are a little frog in a sunny pond full of lily pads. Tap or click where you want to jump, and your frog hops there. Flies buzz above the pads: land close and you snap them up. Golden flies are worth three. Seven rival frogs are after the same flies, and when the 90-second timer runs out, the frog with the most flies wins.

There is no game over. If you miss a pad, you just splash into the water, paddle back to the nearest pad, and keep going.

But do not get too comfortable: a pad sinks if you sit on it for too long, so keep hopping!

Features:
- Super easy to learn: just tap where you want to hop
- Short 90-second rounds, perfect for a quick play
- A fresh pond layout every round
- A live fly count board and a mini map of the whole pond
- Always a full pond: friendly bots join every round, so there is always a game to play
- Earn coins after every round, even when you finish last, and spend them in the Frog Shop on hats and frog skins like Spotted, Poison, Golden and Galaxy
- Watch an optional ad to double your coins or to get bonus coins
- Your coins, hats, and skins are saved to your PlayKovo account
- Works on phones in landscape and on desktop, no install needed
pk-hop-io.controls:
Desktop: click where you want to hop (or press Space to hop toward the mouse), WASD or arrow keys hop in that direction, Esc pauses the game and opens the menu.
Mobile: tap where you want to hop. Play in landscape.

pk-bubble-io.title: Bubble.io
pk-bubble-io.description:
Bubble.io is a bright, fast bubble battle set in a giant bathtub.

You are a soap bubble. Glide around the tub and gobble the floating foam to swell up. The bigger you get, the more air you hold, and once you are noticeably bigger than another bubble you can swallow it whole and keep most of its size. But the same goes for you: anyone much bigger than you can pop you in one gulp, so keep an eye on the size of everyone around you.

Watch out for the grumpy red sea urchins drifting through the tub. Touch one and you lose a chunk of your air, so steer around them or lead your rivals into them.

Features:
- Easy to learn: just steer, eat, and pop
- Puff for a short speed burst to escape a bigger bubble or catch a smaller one, at the cost of some air
- Floaty, bouncy movement that makes every chase feel different
- A live leaderboard of the biggest bubbles and a mini map of the whole tub
- Always a full tub: friendly bots fill the arena, so a round is never empty
- Earn coins from every run and spend them in the Bubble Shop on hats and bubble skins like Rainbow, Swirl, Galaxy and Gold
- Watch an optional ad to float back after being popped, to double your coins, or to get bonus coins
- Your coins, hats, and skins are saved to your PlayKovo account
- Works on phones in landscape and on desktop, no install needed
pk-bubble-io.controls:
Desktop: move the mouse to steer (the farther the cursor, the faster you go), hold the left mouse button or Space to puff, WASD or arrow keys also steer, Esc opens the menu without pausing the game.
Mobile: drag the on-screen stick to steer, hold the PUFF button for a speed burst. Play in landscape.

pk-turf-io-claim-the-land.title: Turf.io - Claim the Land
pk-turf-io-claim-the-land.description:
Turf.io is a free, fast-paced territory game where every move is a risk. You start with a tiny patch of land on a big map full of rivals. Step outside your land and you leave a glowing trail behind you. Make a loop and come back home to claim everything inside it. The longer the loop, the bigger the prize, but the longer your trail stays open for everyone to cut.

That is where the fun starts. If a rival crosses your open trail, you are out and your land disappears. If you cross theirs, they are out and the way to their land is open. Plan short, safe loops to grow steadily, or take a huge risk to grab a giant chunk of the map in a single run. Watch the edge of the map, avoid your own trail and keep an eye on the minimap to hunt down careless players.

Everyone is always moving, so decisions come fast. Take over other players' territory, climb the live top-land list and see how large a share of the map you can own. Each life is quick, and a new one starts in a second.

Earn coins for your best land and the rivals you cut, then spend them in the shop on funny hats and land patterns like dots, stripes, checker and diamonds. Everyone sees your style on your territory. If you get cut, you can optionally watch a short ad to get your land back or to double your coins.

Play on desktop with the keyboard or mouse, or on your phone in landscape mode with a simple touch joystick. No sign-up needed. Pick a nickname and start claiming your turf!
pk-turf-io-claim-the-land.controls:
PC: WASD or arrow keys - steer | Mouse - the head follows the cursor | Esc - open menu (the game keeps running).
Mobile (landscape): Touch and drag the joystick on the left side of the screen to steer | Menu button (bottom-left) - open menu.

pk-sumo-io-push-them-off.title: Sumo.io - Push Them Off
pk-sumo-io-push-them-off.description:
Sumo.io is a free, fast-paced arena brawler where the only goal is to push everyone else into the water. You and nine rivals start on a round wooden platform. After a few seconds it begins to shrink, forcing everyone closer together until only one fighter is left standing.

The controls are simple, but the fights are full of surprises. Slide around with a bit of momentum, bump into rivals to knock them back and time your dash to ram them right off the edge. Big dashes send fighters flying, so be careful not to charge straight off the platform yourself! Grab the power-ups that appear in the ring: a speed boost to out-run the crowd, or a heavy shield that makes you bigger and much harder to push.

Rounds only last about half a minute, so there is always time for one more. Win a round or shove off rivals to earn coins, then spend them in the shop on funny hats and colorful belts. A live preview shows exactly how your fighter will look before you buy. If you get knocked out, you can optionally watch a short ad to jump back into the round or to double the coins you just earned.

Play on desktop with the mouse or keyboard, or on your phone in landscape mode with a simple touch joystick and a big dash button. No sign-up needed. Pick a nickname and start shoving!
pk-sumo-io-push-them-off.controls:
PC: Mouse - move toward the cursor | WASD or arrow keys - alternative movement | Click, Space or Shift - dash and ram | Esc - open menu (the game keeps running).
Mobile (landscape): Touch and drag the joystick on the left side of the screen to move | DASH button - lunge forward and ram rivals | Menu button (bottom-left) - open menu.

pk-plunder-io-pirate-battle.title: Plunder.io - Pirate Battle
pk-plunder-io-pirate-battle.description:
Plunder.io is a free, fast-paced pirate battle royale where only one captain survives. You land on a tropical island with a dozen rival pirates, a cutlass in your hand and treasure scattered everywhere. Collect gold coins, smash treasure chests and grow bigger and tougher with every piece of loot.

Fighting is simple and satisfying. Swing your sword to hit everything in front of you, knock rivals back and send their gold flying across the sand. Time a dash to lunge at an enemy and land a powerful critical strike. As you grow, your weapon upgrades from a cutlass to a silver saber, a mighty battle axe and finally a giant anchor.

But the island is shrinking. A poison gas closes in from the edges and pushes everyone toward the center, forcing fights and punishing the careless. Hide under the palm trees, grab gold from fallen pirates, heal with chests and coins, and stay inside the safe zone while the circle gets smaller and smaller. The last pirate alive wins the round.

Rounds are short and you can jump in at any moment, so there is never any waiting. Get knocked out and a new round starts in seconds. See your placement, count your knockouts and try to climb the live leaderboard every time.

Play on desktop with mouse and keyboard, or on your phone in landscape mode with a touch joystick, a sword button with auto-aim and a dash button. No sign-up needed, just pick a pirate name and start plundering.
pk-plunder-io-pirate-battle.controls:
PC: Mouse - move and aim | Click or Space - swing your sword | Right click or Shift - dash | WASD or arrow keys - alternative movement | Esc - open menu (the game keeps running).
Mobile (landscape): Touch and drag the joystick on the left to move | Sword button - attack (auto-aims at the nearest rival or chest) | DASH button - lunge forward | Menu button (bottom-left) - open menu.

pk-flail-io.title: Flail.io
pk-flail-io.description:
Flail.io is a fast-paced arena .io game where your weapon is a spiked flail chained behind you. Move in circles to swing it faster and faster. When your flail glows red, it's moving at lethal speed: hit a rival's body and they're smashed instantly. Slow hits only push them away.

Collect glowing orbs to grow. The bigger you get, the longer your chain becomes and the heavier your flail swings. Every smashed player spills all of their mass across the arena, so be quick and grab it before anyone else does.

Flails bounce off each other, so you can block an incoming attack with your own flail. Time your swings, protect your body, and outplay rivals who are bigger than you. One hit is all it takes, for them and for you.

Game mode: Endless arena against 12 AI opponents. One life per round; when you're smashed, see your stats and jump right back in.
Characters: Your fighter gets a random color each round. Rivals have their own names and colors, and every one of them carries a flail too.
Stats: Highest mass, time alive, smashes, top leaderboard position and orbs collected.

Features:
- Unique swing physics: build momentum by moving in circles
- Smash rivals with a lethal flail, or block attacks with flail-to-flail clashes
- Grow from a tiny fighter into a giant with a huge flail
- Live leaderboard and minimap
- 8 languages: English, Türkçe, Español, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, Português, Русский
- Plays on desktop and mobile (landscape)
pk-flail-io.controls:
Desktop:
- Mouse: steer (move the cursor closer to your fighter to slow down and swing tighter)
- Left click or Space (hold): boost
- Esc: open the menu (the game keeps running in the background)

Mobile:
- Drag your finger anywhere: steer (closer to your fighter = slower)
- Hold ⚡ (or touch with a second finger): boost
- ☰ button: open the menu

pk-slitword-io.title: Slitword.io
pk-slitword-io.description:
Slitword.io mixes classic snake action with a word game. Your snake is made of Scrabble-style letter tiles, and it reads a word from head to tail. Glide over letters scattered across the arena to grow your word. When it spells a real word, lock it in for points and start fresh with a new letter.

Longer words earn bigger multipliers, and 2x / 3x tiles boost a letter's value. Spell words back to back to build a combo, and watch for Extra Points rounds, when words containing the bonus letter score double.

But watch out: crash into another snake's body or the wall and your letters scatter across the field. Cut off rival snakes to make them drop theirs. You have 3 minutes to climb to the top of the leaderboard.

Features:
- Snake action meets word puzzles
- 8 languages: English, Türkçe, Español, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, Português, Русский
- Each language has its own letters, tile values and word list
- Combos, 2x/3x letter tiles and bonus-letter rounds
- Choose your snake's color
- Plays on desktop and mobile (landscape)
pk-slitword-io.controls:
Desktop:
- Mouse: steer
- Left click or Space (hold): boost
- Q: drop last letter / reroll first letter
- E: lock in word
- Esc: pause

Mobile:
- Drag your finger anywhere: steer
- Hold ⚡ (or touch with a second finger): boost
- ↓ button: drop last letter / reroll first letter
- ✓ button: lock in word
- ⏸ button: pause

pk-superhex-io.title: Superhex.io
pk-superhex-io.description: Superhex.io is a free browser .io game where you conquer as much territory as possible by drawing shapes with your character and connecting them back to your existing territory. Stay alert — if an enemy touches your trail while you're drawing, it's game over.
pk-superhex-io.controls: Mouse or Arrow Keys — control your character.

pk-clashball-io.title: ClashBall.io
pk-clashball-io.description: ClashBall.io is a free browser .io arena game where a dangerous ball chases every player and keeps accelerating over time. Time your slash to avoid elimination and deflect the ball toward your opponents instead. Unlock cosmetics and climb the level ladder as you play.
pk-clashball-io.controls: Mouse — aim and slash (requires pointer-lock). Keyboard — move (WASD or arrow keys).

pk-yohoho-io.title: YoHoHo.io
pk-yohoho-io.description: YoHoHo.io is a free pirate-themed battle royale played entirely in the browser. Marooned on a shrinking island with other players, you fight for loot and survival until only one pirate remains. Create a free account to save your stats and progress across sessions.
pk-yohoho-io.controls: Mouse — move with your cursor, click to attack. Keyboard — move with WASD or arrow keys, SPACE to attack.

pk-minesweeperkovo.title: Minesweeper Kovo
pk-minesweeperkovo.description:
Tidewater Minesweeper is a clean, modern take on the classic puzzle. Uncover every safe tile on the board without hitting a hidden mine. The numbers tell you how many mines touch each tile, so use logic to work out where they are.

Choose Easy, Medium or Hard, and the board fits your screen on both phones and computers. Your first move is always safe, open areas clear automatically, and tapping a number whose flags are all placed opens its neighbors for you. Your best time for each difficulty is saved on your device.
pk-minesweeperkovo.controls: Desktop: left click to open a tile, right click to place a flag, R for a new game, F to toggle flag mode. Mobile: tap to open, long press to place a flag, or use the Flag button to switch to flag mode. Tap a number with all its flags placed to open the surrounding tiles.

pk-tideline.title: Tideline
pk-tideline.description:
Tideline is a complete 3D fishing game that runs right in your browser. Aim and charge your cast, wait for the bobber to plunge, hook the bite and win the tension fight by reeling in bursts and letting go during the red surges, or the line snaps.

Earn cash and experience for every catch, sell your fish at the shop and upgrade your rod, reel, line and bait. Unlock new places like River Bend, the Coastal Pier and the Deep Ocean, and try to complete all 21 species in your journal. The time of day and the weather change which fish bite: salmon rise at dawn and swordfish only appear at night. Your progress saves automatically on your device.
pk-tideline.controls: Desktop: move the mouse to aim, hold Left Click or Space to charge a cast and release to cast, click to hook a bite, hold Click to reel, R to retrieve, B for the shop, M for the map, J for the journal, Esc to pause. Mobile: slide your finger to aim, press and hold to charge and reel, tap to hook the fish, and use the on-screen buttons for Map, Shop, Journal and Pause.

pk-13-steps-to-escape.title: 13 Steps to Escape
pk-13-steps-to-escape.description:
13 Steps to Escape is a 2D pixel art puzzle game. In every level you have to reach the flag. Push crates, pick up keys to open locks, trigger switches, roll a boulder and use many other mechanisms to find your way.

The catch: you only get 13 steps or actions before you respawn, so every move counts. Customize your character, play through the levels, and build your own levels in the built-in level editor to share with friends.
pk-13-steps-to-escape.controls: Move: W A S D, Z Q S D or arrow keys. Confirm: Enter or Space. Undo: E. Restart level: R. Back to menu: Esc. Gamepad: stick to move, A to confirm. The level editor is used with the mouse.

pk-bridge-horror-house.title: Bridge Horror House
pk-bridge-horror-house.description:
You wake up locked inside an abandoned house at night. Three brass keys are hidden in the dark rooms of the kitchen, study and bedroom. Find them, unlock the front door and get out, but you are not alone.

After the second key, a ghost starts stalking you and drifts toward you through the walls. Hold your flashlight beam on him to burn him away, but the beam drains your battery fast. Look for spare batteries in the living room, dining room, hallway and kitchen. The key locations are randomized every run, and the notes you find tell the story of the house. Headphones recommended. Contains sudden loud sounds and flashing images.
pk-bridge-horror-house.controls: Mouse to look, W A S D to move, Shift to sprint, E to interact, F to toggle the flashlight, Esc to pause.

pk-13th-floor.title: 13th Floor
pk-13th-floor.description:
You arrive on the 13th floor for a strange party, but something else is waiting for you. Every room hides a key to the next one, and you must find them all to reach Room 1313.

Use your flashlight to search the rooms and find items, but be careful: when It arrives, you have to stay out of its sight. Watch for its light in the dark corridors, and run and hide if it spots you. Some rooms are unlocked and hide health packs that help you survive.
pk-13th-floor.controls: Desktop: W, A, S, D to move, mouse to look, E or left click to act, F for the flashlight. Mobile: use the left joystick to move, drag on the right side of the screen to look, and use the ACT and LIGHT buttons.

pk-cuberun.title: CubeRun
pk-cuberun.description:
CubeRun is a fast 3D dodging game with a neon synthwave look. Steer your ship through a field of glowing cubes while your speed keeps climbing. Every level changes the colors and the music, and the visuals pulse in time with the soundtrack.

Survive as long as you can, push your score higher and see if you can reach the legendary rainbow level. Your best scores are saved on your device. Inspired by the classic Flash game Cubefield.
pk-cuberun.controls: Move left: A or Left Arrow. Move right: D or Right Arrow. On touch devices, use the on-screen controls.

pk-turbo-kart-rush.title: Turbo Kart Rush
pk-turbo-kart-rush.description:
Turbo Kart Rush is a fast 3D arcade kart racer. Pick one of 8 racers, choose a circuit and fight for first place against seven AI drivers in a Grand Prix.

Drift through corners for speed boosts, hit boost pads and grab item boxes along the track. Use bananas, green and red shells, mushrooms, a star, lightning and more to slow down your rivals or speed past them. Four very different circuits (Sunny Circuit, Dune Drift, Frostbite Falls and Neon Nexus) keep every race fresh.
pk-turbo-kart-rush.controls: Keyboard or gamepad. Use the arrow keys or WASD to steer and accelerate, and the on-screen key hints for drift and item use. Press Enter or click to confirm in the menus.

pk-cream-2048.title: Cream 2048
pk-cream-2048.description: Cream 2048 is a calm, paper-toned take on the classic sliding number puzzle. Slide every tile in one direction, and when two tiles with the same number touch they merge into one with double the value. Plan your moves, keep the board from filling up, and work your way up to the 2048 tile. Undo your last move if you slip, keep going past 2048 for a higher score, and pick up right where you left off — your game and best score are saved automatically.
pk-cream-2048.controls: Desktop — arrow keys or WASD to slide the tiles, Z to undo. Mobile — swipe in any direction on the screen.

pk-nebula-reckoning.title: Nebula Reckoning
pk-nebula-reckoning.description: Nebula Reckoning is a fast arcade space dogfighter set in the Halcyon Drift, a graveyard of empires. As Wren Callis, you pilot a stolen prototype hull against the Vigil, an ancient machine fleet emptying the Drift. Explore a peaceful first sector, mine glowing ore veins, crack open asteroids, salvage wrecks and hail haulers for bounty, delivery and courier contracts, then spool your jump drive into ever more dangerous sectors. Choose from three ships and three difficulty tiers, fight raiders, interceptors, wardens and missile bombers, and take on a capital ship with destructible batteries and a telegraphed annihilator beam. Every death banks credits for permanent Legacy upgrades, and every sector is procedurally generated.
pk-nebula-reckoning.controls: Desktop — mouse to aim, WASD to maneuver, Tab for loadout, V to change view, F cloak, G EMP, H repair, J jump, R to accept a contract, X to decline. Mobile — on-screen analog move/aim sticks and touch buttons for weapons, devices, view and pause.

pk-mazeren.title: Mazeren
pk-mazeren.description: Mazeren is a top-down maze escape game where light and shadow are your only guides. Find the way out of three procedurally built mazes while enemies lurk just beyond your vision. Dash past danger, aim with the mouse and fire arrows to take enemies down, and use the dynamic lighting to spot threats before they spot you. Every run generates new corridors, so no two escapes are the same.
pk-mazeren.controls: WASD to move, Spacebar to dash, move the mouse to aim and left-click to fire arrows, P to pause, M to mute.

pk-13th-guy.title: 13th Guy
pk-13th-guy.description: 13th Guy is a chaotic elimination racing game where you sprint against a crowd of 40 runners across a series of tracks. Only the fastest qualify for the next round, and the slowest are cut every heat. Dodge obstacles, weave through the pack, and stay ahead of the elimination line — one stumble can put you among the unlucky ones who don't make it. Bold, colorful characters and a retro CRT look give every race a punchy arcade feel.
pk-13th-guy.controls: Arrow keys or WASD to run and steer. Press Enter to start a race or continue after a race.

pk-13-c-gauntlet.title: 13°C Gauntlet
pk-13-c-gauntlet.description: You are Juicy, an algae trying to escape a rapidly dissolving Antarctic iceberg. Latch onto ice blocks and slide upward to climb, fighting off hostile organisms and flammable gasses freed from the melting ice as you go. Every 13 seconds the world evolves — red ice blocks vanish and are replaced by fresh terrain or new enemies, so no two runs play the same way. Reach the golden wind rose to escape each stage and push deeper into an endless, increasingly hostile climb. Pick up power-ups along the way for extra weapons, health, and a dash ability to escape tight spots.
pk-13-c-gauntlet.controls: WASD or Arrow Keys to move, Space to attack (and to climb while latched onto an ice block), E to pick up power-ups, Q to use the dash power-up.

pk-operation-ironhold.title: Operation Ironhold
pk-operation-ironhold.description: Operation Ironhold drops you into a hostile container yard with three minutes on the clock and ten enemy soldiers to clear. Choose from four distinct weapons — a full-auto carbine, a pump shotgun, a sidearm, and a bolt-action sniper rifle — each with real recoil, reload animations, and aim-down-sights. Enemies take cover, flank, and call out when they spot you, so every firefight plays out differently. Double jump and mantle let you take the fight to the rooftops and the sniper deck overlooking the yard. Clean, responsive gunplay with a full HUD, minimap, and a detailed after-action report tracking your eliminations, headshots, and accuracy.
pk-operation-ironhold.controls: WASD to move, mouse to look, left click to fire, right click to aim down sights. R to reload, Shift to sprint (or hold breath while scoped), Ctrl to crouch, Space to jump (tap again mid-air to double jump, hold near a ledge to mantle). Number keys 1-4 or mouse wheel to switch weapons, V to toggle fire mode, Esc to pause.

pk-jewelsback.title: Jewelsback
pk-jewelsback.description: Jewelsback is a match-3 puzzle game with a sleek, modern look. Swap adjacent jewels to line up three or more of the same shape and clear them from the board. Chain bigger combos to trigger special jewels with explosive effects like fire, smoke, and rainbow bursts. Progress through 13 increasingly challenging levels and race to reach a score of 13,000 to win. Simple rules, deep combo potential, and a beautifully animated low-poly background make every match satisfying.
pk-jewelsback.controls: Click and drag (or tap and drag on mobile/touch devices) a jewel onto an adjacent one to swap and match.

pk-digger.title: Digger
pk-digger.description: Digger is a fast-paced retro mining game. Guide your miner straight down through procedurally generated underground layers, breaking through dirt and stone in search of gold. Watch out for falling boulders as you carve your way deeper — one hit and it's game over. Simple to pick up, tough to master, with a charming pixel-art sunset backdrop and an endless vertical mine to explore.
pk-digger.controls: Arrow keys / WASD / ZQSD to move and dig (up, down, left, right). Space to restart after game over.

pk-stolen-sword.title: Stolen Sword
pk-stolen-sword.description: Stolen Sword is a one-finger action platformer where every move is a drag gesture. Pull back and release to dash through the air, slicing through enemies with your blade. Fight your way across a series of hand-crafted stages set in a minimalist, atmospheric world — dense bamboo forests, tense duels, and fast, precise combat that rewards timing over button-mashing.
pk-stolen-sword.controls: Desktop — click and drag with the mouse to aim and release to dash/attack. Mobile — touch and drag with one finger to do the same.

pk-desert-nomad.title: Desert Nomad
pk-desert-nomad.description: Desert Nomad is a minimalist endless runner where you guide a stickman traveler across a procedurally scrolling desert. Jump over cacti and rocks, duck under tumbleweeds, and adapt to a dynamic weather system — hot wind, heatwaves, and sandstorms each change your jump height, gravity, and push force in real time. Difficulty ramps up the longer you survive, with procedurally animated running, jumping, and weather reactions bringing the stickman to life.
pk-desert-nomad.controls: Desktop — Space to jump (double jump in air), Down arrow or S to duck, Esc or P to pause. Mobile — tap to jump, swipe down to duck.

pk-space-garden.title: Space Garden
pk-space-garden.description: Space Garden is a minimalist space exploration game where you fly between clusters of planets, harvest resources, and grow a garden of alien life across the cosmos. Navigate tight 13KB-style pixel-art space, manage fuel, and discover what each planet holds.
pk-space-garden.controls: Arrow keys or WASD to fly, Z/Space for action, M for map, H for help.

pk-sky-isles.title: Sky Isles
pk-sky-isles.description: Sky Isles is a relaxing 3D exploration game set across 9 floating grass-topped islands connected by rope bridges and jump pads. Guide your character with a double-jump and a glide cape, ring the five wind chimes in the order shown on an ancient mural, uncover a hidden temple and a koi waterfall, and open the portal to the star isle.
pk-sky-isles.controls: Desktop — WASD/arrow keys to move, mouse drag to rotate camera, Space to jump/double-jump, hold Space mid-air to glide. Mobile — on-screen virtual joystick to move, touch-drag to rotate camera, JUMP button (hold to glide).

pk-hexgl.title: HexGL
pk-hexgl.description: HexGL drops you into the cockpit of a sleek anti-gravity racer streaking through a glowing futuristic city. Steer through tight, banked hexagonal corridors, manage your shield as you clip walls, and time your air brakes to survive sharp turns at full speed. Built with real-time 3D graphics, dynamic lighting, and a driving synth soundtrack, it captures the feel of classic anti-gravity racers in the browser. Push through three laps as fast as you can, chase your best time, and keep boosting even as the track throws sharper curves your way.
pk-hexgl.controls: Turn: Left/Right arrow keys. Accelerate: Up arrow. Air brakes: A/D. Touch and gamepad also supported.

pk-radius-raid.title: Radius Raid
pk-radius-raid.description: Radius Raid drops you into a small ship at the center of an endless enemy swarm. Move with WASD or the arrow keys while aiming and firing with the mouse, twin-stick style, as 13 different enemy types close in from every direction. Collect one of 5 powerup types to shift the balance in your favor, and lean on autofire when things get too hectic to keep your mouse button held down. Layered parallax starfields scroll behind the action, retro sound effects punctuate every kill, and your best runs are saved locally so you always have a score to beat. It's a tight, score-chasing arcade shooter built for one more run.
pk-radius-raid.controls: Move: WASD or Arrow keys. Aim/Fire: mouse. Autofire: F. Pause: P. Mute: M.

pk-q1k3.title: Q1K3
pk-q1k3.description: Q1K3 is a complete first-person shooter built in the spirit of classic Quake, remarkably packed into a tiny footprint for the js13kGames competition. Fight your way through two levels built with real level-design tools, facing five distinct enemy types with genuine line-of-sight AI that will hunt you down without needing pathfinding. Three weapons, dynamic lighting, working doors, and spatial audio (with stereo separation and distance falloff) give the whole thing a surprisingly authentic old-school FPS feel. Collision detection holds up even against fast-moving projectiles, and the soundtrack is an original composition rather than a stock loop. It's a genuine technical showcase as much as a game: proof of how much real 3D shooter can fit in almost nothing.
pk-q1k3.controls: Move: WASD or Arrow keys. Aim: mouse. Attack: left mouse button. Jump: Space or right mouse button. Switch weapon: Q/E or mouse wheel.

pk-tower-building.title: Tower Building
pk-tower-building.description: A crane swings a block back and forth above your growing tower — click or tap at the right moment to drop it. Land it dead-center for a Perfect and rack up bonus points, or land it close enough for a regular Success; either way, the tower grows another floor. Chain consecutive Perfects for an escalating score bonus, but a block that misses the tower entirely costs you one of your three hearts, and running out ends the run. It's a simple, timing-based arcade climb in the spirit of classic tower-stacking games: easy to pick up, hard to put down once you're chasing a new personal best floor count.
pk-tower-building.controls: Click or tap to drop the block. No other controls needed.

pk-midnight-paws.title: Midnight Paws
pk-midnight-paws.description: It is almost midnight, and the darkness is deepening. You're a small mouse trying to cross a string of moonlit, rain-slicked backyards, but a black cat is on the prowl and it's listening for you. Move carefully between bushes to break its line of sight, and watch the fence line — if the cat climbs up on top, it's about to pounce toward wherever you last gave yourself away. Each backyard you clear safely raises your score, but one mistake in the open sends you right back to try again. It's a quiet, atmospheric little stealth game built around patience and timing rather than reflexes: read the cat's behavior, use the environment, and slip through to the next mouse hole before it finds you.
pk-midnight-paws.controls: Move: Arrow keys or WASD. On touch devices: on-screen controls are provided.

pk-dye-hard.title: Dye Hard
pk-dye-hard.description: Corporations have invaded the Crystal Dimension and are draining it of its colors. As its lone defender, you're dropped into an ever-shifting field of vivid, hand-painted streaks and swarmed by an army of animated office supplies — pens, staplers, and worse — sent to stop you. Your character auto-fires at nearby threats while you focus on movement: weave through the swarm, dodge incoming enemies, and hunt down the colored portal arrows at the edges of the screen that mark where the corporate invasion is leaking in. Survive long enough and you level up, picking new powers and upgrades that change how you fight. Between runs, spend what you've earned in the upgrade shop and adjust the difficulty to match your skill. It's a fast, colorful take on the wave-survival genre with a genuinely goofy premise and a satisfying power curve.
pk-dye-hard.controls: Move: WASD or Arrow keys. Aim: mouse. Combat is otherwise automatic.

pk-rainbow-run.title: Rainbow Run
pk-rainbow-run.description: You're a unicorn dashing down an ever-branching rainbow road that curves and forks through a starry sky. Switch between lanes to dodge dark obstacle blocks, jump over low hurdles, and slide under high ones to keep your run alive — timing a slide while airborne even lets you land early for extra control. Collect glowing crystals as you run to spend in the upgrade shop between attempts, boosting things like jump height and extra hits before you go down. Your best distance is tracked every run, so each attempt is a fresh shot at beating your personal record. It's a fast, colorful endless runner built for short bursts: quick reflexes, a satisfying risk-reward loop between grabbing crystals and playing safe, and just one more run always within reach.
pk-rainbow-run.controls: Move: Left/Right arrow keys or A/D. Jump: Up arrow, W, or Space. Slide: Down arrow or S. On touch devices: swipe left/right to change lanes, swipe up to jump, swipe down to slide.

pk-expanding-land.title: Expanding Land
pk-expanding-land.description: A fast-paced multiplayer Agar.io-style cell game built for large numbers of simultaneous players. Start as a small cell, move around the arena, collect food, and absorb smaller players to increase your size. At the same time, avoid larger opponents that can consume you. The goal is to grow as large as possible, climb the leaderboard, and survive for as long as you can. Sessions are quick to understand but highly competitive, with constant movement, positioning, risk assessment, and opportunities to hunt or escape other players. The game is designed to remain smooth and responsive even when the arena contains a very large player population.
pk-expanding-land.controls:
Desktop: Move the mouse to guide your cell around the arena. Default button for ejecting mass is W, and for splitting is SPACE. 
Mobile/Tablet: Touch and drag on the screen to move your cell.
Additional action buttons, when available, can be used for special abilities such as splitting or ejecting mass.

pk-13-seconds.title: 13 Seconds
pk-13-seconds.description: You are a weaponized AI virus infiltrating the network of an alien race that has enslaved humanity for over two centuries. The alien antivirus will find and delete you in just 13 seconds — but death isn't the end. Every time you're caught, you respawn and can follow the exact path your previous attempt carved through the system, using your own backtrace as a shield or shortcut. Race through a striking low-poly, neon-lit 3D maze of hexagonal chambers, collecting corrupted data and disabling power generators and weapon systems level by level. Precise, twitchy movement and a hard time limit make every run tense and short, while the trail-based respawn mechanic turns repeated failure into a puzzle-like tool for planning your next attempt. Clear every level and destroy the alien network's main memory core to free humanity. Originally released as xx142-b2.exe, winner of the Overall/Desktop category at js13kGames 2019.
pk-13-seconds.controls: Move: WASD or Arrow keys. Restart current attempt: Backspace.

pk-underrun.title: Underrun
pk-underrun.description: Underrun drops you into a compromised facility crawling with rogue security systems. Armed with a plasma pistol, you fight your way through three increasingly dangerous levels, gunning down skittering spider-bots and stationary sentry turrets while hunting down every offline CPU terminal scattered across the map. Reboot all of a level's systems to unlock the path forward — but watch your health bar, because damage adds up fast and going down means restarting the level from your last checkpoint. Health pickups are scattered around each map to keep you in the fight, and the retro CRT-terminal presentation and dark synth soundtrack give every corridor a tense, claustrophobic edge. It's a short, replayable arcade shooter built for quick sessions: three tight levels, no fluff, just clear the systems and get out.
pk-underrun.controls: Move: Arrow keys or WASD. Aim: mouse. Shoot: hold the left mouse button. Click once at the start screen to enable audio and begin.

pk-cozy-bakehouse.title: Cozy Bakehouse
pk-cozy-bakehouse.description:
Cozy Bakehouse is a relaxing merge and bakery management game where you build a cozy café from the ground up, one merge at a time. Drag and combine matching ingredients — flour, coffee beans, dough, pastries — to unlock better generators, fulfill customer orders, and level up your bakery under the guidance of Chef Aleyna.

Explore over 70 uniquely themed islands, each with its own decor, generators, and merge chains to discover. As your café grows, unlock new recipes, collect gold and diamonds, spin the reward wheel, and open treasure chests packed with rare items. Complete customer orders to earn XP, decorate your café your way, and race toward the next island unlock.

It's an easy-to-learn, hard-to-put-down merge puzzle game — perfect for short coffee-break sessions or long relaxed play. No download, no signup: just open your browser and start merging, baking, and building your dream bakery empire.

Play free online, works on both desktop and mobile browsers.
pk-cozy-bakehouse.controls: Tap and drag with your mouse (desktop) or finger (mobile/tablet) to move and merge items on the board. Tap buttons on the side panel to open chests, check quests, and access the shop.

pk-penalty-strike-3d.title: Penalty Strike 3D
pk-penalty-strike-3d.description: Swipe the ball, score goals, customize your team, smash the targets and become the legends of football!
pk-penalty-strike-3d.controls:
Welcome to Penalty Strike 3D — a thrilling 3D penalty shootout simulator! Step up as the striker in a packed stadium. Swipe your finger or drag your mouse to send the ball flying at the goal. Curve it in mid-air to bend around the defensive wall and fool the keeper, and keep an eye on the wind — it changes before every shot.

Work through 50 levels of rising difficulty, from simple strikes to challenges with jumping defenders and lightning-fast goalkeepers. On some levels you take the gloves yourself and dive to make the save. When you want a real test, endless mode and the timed target mode are waiting.

Hit the top corners, build up streaks and earn coins. Unlock 10 unique balls, 7 kits, boots, flight trails and 4 stadium themes. Name your team, pick its colours, claim daily rewards and spin the fortune wheel.

Become the legendary champion of the penalty shootout!

pk-merge-arena.title: Merge Arena
pk-merge-arena.description: Evolution Merge Arena is a fast-paced browser survival game. Start as a tiny cell, bump into matching memes to merge and evolve, and dodge anything bigger than you. Climb the evolution path from a lowly clown all the way to a cosmic legend while avoiding bigger players in the arena
pk-merge-arena.controls: Desktop: move the mouse relative to your cell to steer. Mobile: touch and drag anywhere to steer.
